name: Teen Service Group (library volunteers)
what_you_do: Help the youth and teen librarians plan and run programs, sign kids up for the Reading Program, and do other tasks all year.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The group runs year-round.

org: Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum and Leslie Science & Nature Center (Discover Science and Nature)
what_you_do: Help at the science museum and nature center. The page lists staffing the preschool areas, preparing distance learning kits for school groups, and cleaning indoor and outdoor sites. Leslie also has wildlife volunteering.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are posted.

what_you_do: After 6 training sessions, you can volunteer on your own. Jobs include cat comforting, dog visiting and shelter cleaning. Others are cat feeding, making enrichment toys and camp counseling. There are also events.

name: Young Filmmakers Camp (Michigan Theater and State Theatre)
org: Marquee Arts (Michigan Theater and State Theatre)
what_you_do: Learn to make films from working pros. Three weeks cover planning, filming and editing. The camp ends with a red carpet show of your films.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed Friday, June 19, 2026 at 5 PM. 2027 dates and prices are not posted.

name: #MI-Internship Prep (4-week free course)
what_you_do: Take a free 4 week course. Explore careers, build job skills, and make a portfolio with a resume and cover letter. Each week you meet a top employer.
deadline_text: Cohorts run throughout the year. No dates are posted on the page.

what_you_do: Drop in after school or join weekly programs. Some are music production, running a concert venue, game design, and first job and college planning. Teens can also start their own project.

name: Leadership Institute (Ozone House)
what_you_do: One week of workshops. Topics are public speaking, money and credit, art, teamwork, and help in your community. Youth help plan and run it.
deadline_text: Dates are not posted. The page says it is offered twice a year.

name: Ann Arbor lifeguard certification course and pool jobs
org: City of Ann Arbor Parks and Recreation (Mack Indoor Pool)
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard course (lifeguarding, first aid, CPR and AED). If you are hired at one of the city's pools, the $200 course fee is refunded. The city also hires seasonal staff at pools, golf courses and canoe liveries.
deadline_text: Registration for the course opens Jan 21, 2027. Session 1 starts Friday, April 16, 2027 (Friday 5 to 10 p.m., then Saturday and Sunday 11 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.). Registration closes 7 days before the course starts. Seasonal job postings for 2027 are not up yet.

name: Volunteer in the Parks (City of Ann Arbor)
org: City of Ann Arbor Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Sign up for park projects such as the Huron River cleanup, Trash Trailblazers, Breeding Bird Survey, Adopt-a-Park and playground maintenance. Groups of 5 to 30 can request a project.
deadline_text: No deadline. Event dates are on the online volunteer calendar.

what_you_do: High school students work with Peace staff and interns as counselors at Summer Day Camp. Rising 9th graders can join as Counselors in Training.
deadline_text: Dates and application steps are not posted on the page.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the summer festival's Top of the Park site. Teen roles include the Welcome Team and Zero Waste Champions. Others are Donation Ambassadors and Merch Mavens. Each shift you finish earns perks. One perk is access to special hospitality areas.
deadline_text: The page says sign-up opens April 1 (for the 2026 season). Festival dates are not on this page. 2027 sign-up is not posted yet.

name: SummerWorks (Washtenaw County Summer Youth Employment Program)
org: SummerWorks: Michigan Works! Southeast, Washtenaw County OCED, University of Michigan Poverty Solutions and partners
what_you_do: You get weekly professional development. You get an adult mentor. If you are selected, you get a paid 10 week summer internship with a local employer.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 15 and were due Mar 22, 2026; internship period June 15 to Aug 21, 2026. The site says 2027 applications open in mid-January and are usually open late January to late March. 2027 closing date is not posted.

name: Trinity Health Ann Arbor Teen Volunteer Program
org: Trinity Health Michigan, Ann Arbor and Livingston

deadline_text: No application dates posted. The newest date on the page is old: a summer teen orientation on June 24, 2026. No later orientation is listed. Ask the volunteer office about the next one.

name: Electrify Tech Camp
org: University of Michigan, Electrical and Computer Engineering
what_you_do: A summer day camp run by U-M engineers. You pick a topic like solar cells, chips, lasers, quantum, electric cars or AI. You do not need to know any of it first.
deadline_text: The 2027 application date is not posted. Fill out the Electrify 2027 interest form to be told when it opens.

name: Future Ready Scholars at the University of Michigan
org: Michigan Engineering Zone, University of Michigan College of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on the U-M Ann Arbor campus solving real problems with the engineering design process. You also build math, reading, writing and study skills. Monthly Saturday sessions follow.
deadline_text: 2026 camp: July 5 to 17, 2026. The application was due April 5, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

deadline_text: The 2027 application opens in mid-January 2027 (exact date not posted). Admission is rolling until courses fill, so apply early.

org: University of Michigan School of Music, Theatre and Dance

what_you_do: Build an art and design portfolio for college in a 2 week studio program with Stamps faculty. Learn about art school admission from the Stamps admission team.

org: University of Michigan Women in Science and Engineering (WISE)
what_you_do: Spend a week in U-M labs. Pick a morning major. The 2026 choices were Outer Space, Game Design and Biodiversity. In the afternoon, try other subjects with U-M student leaders.

name: Washtenaw County Youth Commission
org: Washtenaw County Youth Commission (run through the Neutral Zone)

deadline_text: 2026 edition: apply by August 28; competition Saturday October 3 (2026). Next dates not posted.

name: Luddy Cybersecurity Immersion Camp (Indiana University)
org: Indiana University Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
what_you_do: Work in teams for a week. You design your own cybersecurity projects with tools such as Wireshark and Nmap. This year's camp also looks at artificial intelligence.
deadline_text: 2027 camp: June 2027. No application dates are posted on the page.

name: Luddy Precollege Summer STEM Camp (Indiana University)
org: Indiana University Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
what_you_do: Live on the IU campus in a residential summer camp. Learn to use Python to control systems and design tools for problems in engineering, science and society. Luddy School experts teach you.
deadline_text: 2027 camp: July (dates to be announced). The page says applications open in January 2027.

name: Midsummer Theatre Camp (IU Theatre and Drama)
org: Department of Theatre and Drama, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: Three weeks of acting, singing and dance classes and rehearsals with IU faculty and pro artists. The camp ends with public shows of Chicago: Teen Edition. Students also help with the tech side of the show.
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran July 5 to 26, 2026. Application review began April 1 and continued until all slots were filled. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Rising Leaders Program
org: Paul H. O'Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A program of several days on the IU campus. O'Neill teachers lead classes on leading, public policy and community work. You meet IU students and learn about majors and careers.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was March 1 and decisions went out by March 25. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: OPEN Program (take IU Bloomington classes while in high school)
what_you_do: Qualified local juniors and seniors can take IU Bloomington courses. You earn college credit. You can take them during the school year or in summer. Spots depend on space available.
deadline_text: Applications accepted about three months before to two weeks before each semester starts. No late applications.

name: Youth Environmental Leadership Summit (YELS)
org: Environment, Society, and Sustainability Institute, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A one-day visit to IU for high school students. You tour environmental research labs and join a hands-on workshop led by IU faculty.
deadline_text: Student registration opens in fall 2026. The exact date and the event date are not posted on the page.

name: Monroe County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and complete hands-on projects in subjects you choose, with adult volunteers and staff to guide you. There are community clubs and project clubs, and you can attend any club meeting you like.
grades: Grades 3 to 12 (Mini 4-H is grades K to 2)
deadline_text: Enrollment in Indiana 4-H opens every year on Oct 1. The county asks you to be enrolled and have your clubs picked by January 15. The page does not print the year for January 15, so no date is set. The 2026 Monroe County Fair was June 27 to July 5, 2026.

name: City of Bloomington Volunteer Network
org: City of Bloomington, Community and Family Resources
what_you_do: A free site that lists volunteer jobs from 300 or more local nonprofits, plus events and trainings. You make an account and sign up for opportunities.
deadline_text: No deadline. Each opportunity has its own date.

grades: Entering grade 7 or higher in the fall of the next school year
name: Teen Volunteer
org: WonderLab Museum of Science, Health, and Technology
what_you_do: Teens share their enthusiasm with museum visitors. The page lists no birthday party or outreach roles.
deadline_text: Submit the Teen Volunteer Application (linked on the Become a Volunteer page), then register for a volunteer orientation. Orientation sessions were listed through Tuesday, November 10, 2026 (prior registration required). The page does not say applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

grades: Entering grade 9 per the Become a Volunteer page. The internship page says entering grades 9-12 or home-school equivalent. Graduating seniors may also apply.
name: WonderCamp High School Summer Intern
org: WonderLab Museum of Science, Health, and Technology
what_you_do: Volunteer your time this summer as a WonderCamp High School Intern. The page lists no specific duties.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2026 are closed. The page says to check back for summer 2027. Dates not posted.

name: King Conservation Science Explorers (middle school)
what_you_do: Middle school students do hands-on STEAM projects on Saturdays at the zoo and nearby places. They share a final talk. The 2026-27 theme is being a responsible consumer.
deadline_text: Applications open twice a year: September 1 to October 1 and March 1 to April 1. The fall 2026 window has closed. Years for future windows are not printed on the page.

name: King Conservation Science Scholars
what_you_do: High school students join workshops, classes and public programs at the zoo. They learn public speaking by teaching guests, take STEAM classes and prep for college and careers. Regular participants can apply for scholarships, travel and seasonal zoo jobs.
deadline_text: Applications open twice a year. Fall: September 1 to October 1 (onboarding early to mid November). Spring: March 1 to April 1 (onboarding early to mid May). The fall 2026 window has closed. Years for future windows are not printed on the page.

name: College Preview (pre-college art and design program)
what_you_do: You spend two weeks on campus. You take college-level classes in an art or design major. You earn college credit. You build a portfolio. You show work in a gallery exhibition.
deadline_text: 2026 session: registration opened Nov 3, 2025, scholarship applications closed April 27, 2026, registration closed May 11, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: 4-H Memorial Camp Junior Counselor
org: Illinois 4-H Memorial Camp, University of Illinois Extension
city: Monticello, IL (about 30 miles southwest of Champaign)
what_you_do: Junior counselors live at a summer camp near Allerton Park and help run camp sessions for youth. All camp staff get a week of paid training first.
deadline_text: The page says applications open in December and stay open until positions are filled. The dates listed on the page are for summer 2026, so 2027 dates are not posted.

grades: Junior or senior in high school when you apply
name: Pre-College Cancer Engineering Summer Institute (PRE-CE)
org: Cancer Center at Illinois, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Join a faculty research team at the Cancer Center at Illinois for the summer. You are paired with another high school student in the same lab. You also do career workshops and get mentoring.
deadline_text: Dates and the deadline are announced with application materials each fall. 2027 dates are not posted on the page.

name: Carle Foundation Hospital Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You volunteer at Carle Foundation Hospital. You can be a high school or college student. About 500 students volunteer each semester.
deadline_text: Applications are due by 5 p.m. on August 29 (fall term), November 15 (spring term) or April 15 (summer term). The page gives no year.

name: Youth Services (Workforce Development)
what_you_do: Get career planning and job search help. Get resume and interview practice. Get work experience. These services are for young people at the Champaign County workNet center.
deadline_text: None stated on the page.

name: Champaign-Urbana Community Fab Lab Summer Camps
org: Champaign-Urbana Community Fab Lab, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Week-long morning or afternoon camps on coding, electronics, game design, digital illustration, textiles, 3D modeling and more.
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Counselor-in-Training, Summer Day Camps
what_you_do: You volunteer as a counselor-in-training. You work at summer day camps. The camps are at Homer Lake and Lake of the Woods forest preserves.
deadline_text: No application dates posted.

name: Pet Pals Club
what_you_do: A monthly hands-on club for animal lovers. Each meeting has a talk or activity on animal welfare or sheltering, and time with the shelter animals.
deadline_text: Sessions: March to May, June to August, September to November, January to March.

name: Illini Summer Academies
org: Illinois 4-H and University of Illinois Extension
what_you_do: Live in a campus dorm for a week and take a hands-on academy led by university departments. Topics change each year. The 2026 list included digital farming, and breeding and genes.
deadline_text: ISA 2027: registration opens in February 2027 (exact date not posted). The academy list is posted in early January 2027. In 2026, early registration ran Feb 9 to Mar 1 and the deadline was Apr 17.

name: Arabic High School Program
org: Department of Linguistics, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Take a two-week beginner class in Modern Standard Arabic on campus for 2 college credits. You also join conversation tables, cooking, calligraphy and field trips. You live in a campus dorm.
deadline_text: Tentative application deadline April 11, 2027 (11:59 pm CST). Registration deadline April 26, 2027 (11:59 pm CST). Final payment May 28, 2027 (11:59 pm CST). The page says dates may be adjusted as the spring semester approaches. The early admission date of March 8, 2026 has passed.

name: Discover Architecture
org: School of Architecture, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: This is a one-week summer program on campus where you live in a dorm. You learn drawing and modeling in a design studio. You see what life is like as an architecture student. You take a trip to a famous building in the Midwest.
deadline_text: Registration opens Nov 1, 2026. No due date; it closes when the program is full.

name: Illinois MakerLab Summer Camps
org: Illinois MakerLab, Gies College of Business, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: One week, 3 hours a day camps on 3D modeling, 3D printing, Minecraft, generative AI and robot arms in the MakerLab at the Business Instructional Facility.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 camps ran June 1 to July 31 and are over. Summer 2027 details will be announced in early 2027.

name: SpHERES High School Research Program
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (College of Medicine and College of LAS)
what_you_do: Work in a campus lab on a research project with a mentor for six weeks. You also go to weekly talks on how to share science and get ready for college. You show your work at a closing poster event.
deadline_text: The College of Medicine page says applications open in Spring 2027. No closing date is posted.

grades: Junior high and grades 8 to 12 (varies by ensemble)
name: Illinois Summer Youth Music (ISYM)
org: School of Music, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Students spend one week at a campus music camp in band, chorus, orchestra, jazz, rock band, musical theatre or black chorus, with university faculty and visiting teachers.
deadline_text: Registration opens in early 2027. Tentative 2027 weeks: June 21 to 26, June 28 to July 3, July 12 to 17.

name: Volunteer at OSF Sacred Heart Medical Center (Urbana)
org: OSF HealthCare, OSF Sacred Heart Medical Center - Urbana (formerly Heart of Mary)
what_you_do: Volunteers help patients, visitors and caregivers at the hospital. The page does not list the jobs.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Call Volunteer Services to ask if applications are open.

name: Champaign Park District Seasonal and Summer Jobs
what_you_do: These are seasonal park district jobs. Examples are lifeguard and swim instructor at Sholem Aquatic Center. Others are summer camp staff, Prairie Farm, sports and grounds positions.
deadline_text: No application dates or deadlines listed on the page.

name: Champaign Park District Teen Volunteering
what_you_do: You can volunteer at parks and programs. Examples include special events and Prairie Farm (May to August). Others are Virginia Theatre, sports and summer programs.
deadline_text: No deadline. Volunteers register on the Champaign Park District Volunteer Portal.

name: Dual Credit and Dual Enrollment at Parkland College
what_you_do: You can take Parkland College classes while in high school. You can take them on campus, online or at your high school. You earn college credit. In some cases, you also earn high school credit.
deadline_text: No deadline on the page. Ask the Early College office.

name: DiscoverU Teen Camps
what_you_do: Short career and hobby camps for teens, taught by professional educators and experts. Camps cover areas that can lead to careers.
deadline_text: The page says registration will open February 2027. Dates will be posted soon.

name: Early College and Career Academy (ECCA)
org: Education for Employment System #330 and Parkland College
what_you_do: High school juniors and seniors take career classes at Parkland College (such as automotive, nursing assistant, computer programming, construction trades or EMS) and earn high school and college credit. Classes are in early morning.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Admitted students meet in May for summer orientation.

name: Summer Start
org: Parkland College, Career and Community Engagement
what_you_do: A paid career exploration program at Parkland College. Students explore college and career programs, meet faculty and staff, and make friends.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Friday, April 24, 2026 at 5 pm. No 2027 dates posted.

name: Youth Police Explorer Post 258
what_you_do: Teens learn about police careers through classes and hands-on training, such as building searches, traffic stops and crash investigation, and do community service.
deadline_text: Apply any time. New orientations happen every spring. Applications are kept on file.

name: Champaign Public Library Volunteers
what_you_do: You can help with sorting and shelving. You can work bookstore cashier shifts. You can help with storytime. You can help with a summer Club Fred program. Other roles are listed. Training is provided.
deadline_text: No deadline.

grades: Rising 7th to 12th grade. Individual camps have narrower ranges, such as 7th to 9th or 10th to 12th.
name: Grainger Engineering Summer Camps
what_you_do: These are week-long camps. You do hands-on projects and tour labs. Illinois engineering faculty and students teach you. Areas include aerospace, bioengineering, electronics, AI and quantum.
deadline_text: All 2026 camps are listed as full. 2027 application dates are not posted. The FAQ page says applications usually open in February, with priority deadlines in late March.

name: University of Illinois Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: Office of the Chancellor and Illinois Human Resources, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Local high school students work in a campus department on projects, office support, research or event prep. They also attend about 2 to 3 hours of job skills sessions, usually on Fridays.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was set for June 15 to Aug 7, 2026 (tentative). No 2027 dates are posted yet. Departments are encouraged to express interest early.

name: Young Scholars STEMM Research Program
what_you_do: You do six weeks of real research in a University of Illinois lab. Topics include neuroscience, AI, physics and bioengineering. You take part in seminars. You give a poster. There is a final symposium.
deadline_text: Applications Closed for Summer 2026.

name: Youth Employment Services (YES)
org: City of Champaign with Champaign Unit 4 School District
what_you_do: Unit 4 students are placed with local employers for a six-week summer work experience. The program also supports students during the school year.
deadline_text: The city page does not post 2027 dates. It says YES places students with local employers for six weeks each summer.

name: Teen Volunteer at The Urbana Free Library
what_you_do: Teens 14 to 18 help the library. Jobs include finding books and items, helping with programs, the seed swap, gardening and book sale setup. Some roles, like Teen Open Lab, need an interview.
deadline_text: Apply any time. No deadline is posted.

name: Counselor-in-Training (CIT) Program
what_you_do: You help lead summer day camp activities. You assist counselors and campers. You set personal goals. You meet weekly with other CITs.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due March 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: FRESH Crew Teen Volunteer Days
what_you_do: Join Saturday stewardship days in local parks: collect prairie seed, pull invasive plants and clear trash. No experience needed.
deadline_text: No registration. Fall 2026 dates: Oct 3, Oct 17, Nov 7, Nov 21, Dec 5 (2 to 4 pm).

name: Astro Ambassadors
what_you_do: Teens see how the Adler plans guest visits behind the scenes. They learn to lead hands-on science activities and share ideas with staff. Then they run the activities for guests on the museum floor.
deadline_text: Applications for the spring 2027 session open in early 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Far Horizons Teens
what_you_do: Teens join Adler researchers to study light pollution in and around Chicago. One long study looks at how light affects trees. Teens also make a science poster and give a talk.
deadline_text: Applications for the spring 2027 session open in early 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Advocate Health Care hospital volunteers (ages 16 and up)
city: Chicago area, IL (including Advocate Sherman Hospital in Elgin)
what_you_do: Volunteer at an Advocate hospital near you, in departments matched to your interests. Most spots are a set shift of 2 to 4 hours once a week. There are no shadowing roles.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply to the hospital you want any time.

name: Teen Ambassadors
what_you_do: Teens learn the history of their own neighborhood. They practice public speaking and interviews and visit old buildings. Then they work as guides at the Open House Chicago festival in October.
deadline_text: 2026 round: priority deadline August 21, notices August 25, confirm by August 31. The page says it is sold out.

name: Teen Fellows
what_you_do: A 15 month program about architecture and design. Fellows do a six week summer session, take fall and spring terms, and finish with a paid second-summer internship.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 round is closed. The page says applications for Summer 2027 to Summer 2028 open in November. Last deadline was March 31.

name: Art Institute of Chicago Teen Council
what_you_do: A group of 15 teens works with museum staff. They plan programs and tools that make the museum more welcoming and useful for Chicago-area youth. Members meet at the museum and go behind the scenes.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 Teen Council application was open through June 30, 2026. 2027-28 dates not posted.

name: Art Institute of Chicago Teen Summer Internship
org: Art Institute of Chicago with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help with festivals, gallery tours and workshops. They meet museum workers and local artists. They also plan and host creative events for visitors.
deadline_text: Applications open in the spring through After School Matters. Exact 2027 dates not posted.

org: Chicago Botanic Garden, Science Career Continuum
what_you_do: Rising CPS juniors and seniors take a college-level environmental science class and get a mentor. They do a summer research project. Through the school year they get help with college applications. The job is paid, with school-year stipends.
deadline_text: Page says the application deadline is Tuesday, April 15 (no year shown).

name: Science First (grades 9 and 10)
org: Chicago Botanic Garden, Science Career Continuum
what_you_do: Rising CPS freshmen and sophomores spend four weeks at the Garden. They learn about nature, biology, ecology and environmental justice. They do group projects and show them to family and friends. Students are paid.
deadline_text: Page says the application deadline is Tuesday, April 15 (no year shown).

name: Summer at Columbia
what_you_do: A four-week program for high school students. You take a freshman-level college class in the arts, media or communications. Your teachers work in those fields. Credits can count if you enroll at Columbia later.
deadline_text: 2026 registration has closed. 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Sophomores, juniors and seniors in fall 2027

org: DePaul University, Driehaus College of Business
what_you_do: Take a one-week class with team projects in money, sales, business and accounting. You pitch a new idea for a business. You earn a business certificate.
deadline_text: 2027 dates and sign-up are not posted yet. The page says to check back later. Late sign-ups go on a waitlist.

org: DePaul University, Driehaus College of Business

what_you_do: Live on campus for five days and four nights in a team sponsored by a company. Learn markets and valuation, use Excel and Bloomberg tools, then pitch a stock idea to professionals.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline are posted on the page.

org: Economic Awareness Council (with DePaul University Writing Center)
what_you_do: Research and write an article for On the Money Magazine. Teens write it, and it is about money and starting a business. You also build resume, speaking, writing and interview skills.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 interviews were tentatively in September. No closing date is stated. A spring internship is announced but its dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Each summer, 15 Chicago-area high school students pick a Field Museum scientist or expert. They do a 5-week research project. They also learn digital media, tech and career skills.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. The page says to check back in early 2027 for next summer.

name: Chicago Green Ambassadors Summer Program
org: The Field Museum, Keller Science Action Center (Roots and Routes Initiative and Youth Conservation Action)
what_you_do: Paid summer interns link their neighborhoods with the Burnham Wildlife Corridor. It is a nature area on the south lakefront. Interns work on real problems in the environment and in the community.
deadline_text: Dates and application not posted on the program page.

name: Field Museum Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens greet visitors and share science stories. They help young kids in the Crown Family PlayLab and show real specimens at interpretive carts in Stanley Field Hall.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Jan 2026 to Feb 28, 2026. Interviews late March or early April; final notice by May 8. The page says check back in early 2027.

name: Free Spirit Media Teen Programs
what_you_do: Teens learn screenwriting, editing, camera work, audio and acting. Programs run after school, in school and in summer. Teens also get job skills training.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 programs: Sept 21 to Nov 20, 2026. Registration deadline not stated.

name: Building Leaders teen program
what_you_do: A free after-school program for teens. It has homework help, science and art projects, college visits, financial aid workshops and service hours. Gads Hill says teens can also find job chances through After School Matters and One Summer Chicago.
deadline_text: Enrolling now per the site. No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Juniors get 8 weeks of training in business and tech skills. In senior year they work a paid internship at a partner company for about 20 hours a week. The internship lasts a year. They also get college and career coaching.
deadline_text: No 2026-27 application dates are posted on the program pages.

name: Goodman Musical Theater Intensive
what_you_do: A free summer program. Teens train in acting, singing and dancing with professional musical theater artists. They perform in a show at the Goodman.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed; callbacks were Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Goodman PlayBuild Youth Intensive
what_you_do: A free summer theater program. Teens learn acting, creative writing, improv and physical theater from pros. They create an original show about civic issues.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed; callbacks were Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Goodman Youth Arts Council (GYAC)
what_you_do: CPS students use theater to talk about issues that young people face. They plan and run events by teens for teens. They learn from Goodman artists and staff, and they act as ambassadors for the theater.
deadline_text: Applications for 2025/26 are closed. 2026/27 dates not posted on the program page.

name: RISE Teen Program
org: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry (MSI Chicago)
what_you_do: A free program where teens explore careers in science, tech, engineering, arts and math. You do hands-on projects, LEGO engineering challenges and panels with pros and mentors. You can join a 12-week session or drop in.
deadline_text: Registration for the Fall 2026 session has closed. Next session dates not posted.

name: Chicago Metro History Day
what_you_do: Students pick a topic that fits the yearly theme and research it like a historian. Then they make a website, show, film, paper or exhibit. Volunteers judge the projects at yearly contests in the Chicago area.

name: Broadway Youth Center (drop-in, health and housing connections)
what_you_do: A drop-in center for young people. It offers medical care, social help and mental health care. It also links you to housing and other help.

name: Bronzeville Youth Shelter (emergency shelter for ages 14 to 17)
what_you_do: A safe, temporary place to stay for teens with nowhere to go. Ignite also runs a drop-in resource center.
deadline_text: No deadline. A 24/7 help line is listed.

what_you_do: Youth make a plan with a case manager for school, GED, college or certificates. Then they do four weeks of job workshops, then an eight week paid internship with a local employer.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Camp Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help counselors run Conservation Camp for young kids. They set up activities, join in and help make camp fun. They earn service hours and an EcoLeader certificate.
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Conservation Ambassadors Board
org: Lincoln Park Zoo with After School Matters
what_you_do: Each semester, teens study one conservation topic in depth. Then they plan and carry out a project and share it with peers and the public. They build skills in leadership, research, speaking, event planning, promotion and money.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 application opened Jan 20 and was due Feb 1. A fall term also runs. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Nature Buds Internship
org: Lincoln Park Zoo with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help run nature play for the zoo's youngest visitors. There is music, art, story time and sensory bins. Interns also help kids and the adults with them find their way around the zoo.
deadline_text: The summer 2026 application was to open the week of April 27 on the After School Matters site. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Malott Family Research Apprenticeship Program
what_you_do: Apprentices work with zoo researchers on a real science question. They learn research methods in the field and on computers. At the end of summer they show their results at a poster session.
grades: Entering grades 11 to 12, or freshman year of college
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Malott Family Zoo Intern Program
what_you_do: Interns teach zoo guests about animals and conservation. They learn how to share conservation messages. They meet zoo researchers and animal care staff. They finish with a project they present.
grades: Entering grades 10 to 12, or freshman year of college
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Zoo Teens events
what_you_do: Free events just for teens, led by zoo experts. You can make conservation art, learn to live next to city wildlife like bats and birds, and play a role-playing game.
deadline_text: Events: Saturday Oct 31 (Roll for Wildlife, Prism Games, Logan Square) and Saturday Nov 7 (Plants and Prints, Lincoln Park Zoo). The page has no year, but both weekdays match 2026. Register on the page.

name: Marwen Art@Work summer internship

deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 open in spring 2027. For 2026 they were due April 11, 2026.

name: Teen Creative Agency (TCA)
what_you_do: Chicago teens meet each week with two lead artists. They spend time in the galleries and at other culture sites. They make art projects and public events, including the yearly teen show called 21Minus.
deadline_text: Applications open in the spring, per the page. Exact dates not posted.

name: CPS Student Advisory Council (Mikva Challenge)
what_you_do: Students from 20+ Chicago schools meet with CPS leaders. They gather ideas from peers and do research. Then they write advice on school issues. Past groups spoke to the CPS Board.
grades: Citywide Youth Councils are for current 9th to 11th graders
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

grades: Citywide Youth Councils are for current 9th to 11th graders
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Mikva Student Election Judge Program
org: Mikva Challenge Illinois with Chicago election officials
what_you_do: High school juniors and seniors work at polling places on Election Day. They do the same jobs as adult judges. They help voters, run the machines and close the polls.
deadline_text: Each election cycle. No dates posted on the page.

name: Mikva Summer Fellows
org: Mikva Challenge Illinois with the Illinois Department of Human Services Youth Investment Program
what_you_do: Fellows work for six weeks in the offices of city, county, state and federal leaders. They also go to weekly workshops on leadership, setting goals and job skills.
grades: Placed after senior year of high school
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Recreation Leader in Training (RIT), ages 13 to 15
