deadline_text: 2026 sessions: Winter Jan 12 to Mar 14 (programs viewable online Dec 1, 2025), Spring Apr 6 to Jun 6, Summer Jun 22 to Jul 31, Fall Oct 5 to Dec 11 (viewable online July 27). 2027 dates not posted.

name: Chicago Park District summer jobs (lifeguard, recreation leader, junior laborer)
what_you_do: Teens 16 and up can work in the parks. Jobs include lifeguard and day camp recreation leader. You can also be a special recreation leader. Those camps serve kids and adults with intellectual disabilities. Junior laborers do landscape work.
deadline_text: All four 2026 summer positions are marked closed. 2027 dates not posted. The Park District holds free Teen Opportunity Fairs in Feb and March (Feb 21 to Mar 14 in 2026) where teens can apply.

name: Rush University Medical Center volunteer program
what_you_do: Volunteers greet visitors and walk them to where they need to go. They push wheelchairs, deliver flowers and mail, visit with patients and help with events. After six months you can apply for a role in one department.
deadline_text: New volunteers are always welcome, per the page. No deadline is stated.

name: SAIC Early College Program (ECP) courses
org: School of the Art Institute of Chicago
what_you_do: High school students take art and design classes in fall, spring or summer. Examples are figure drawing, animation, fashion and comics. You build work for your portfolio for art school.
grades: High school; college credit only for those who finished sophomore year
deadline_text: Register online for each term. No fixed deadline stated on the program pages.

name: SAIC Early College Program Summer Institute (ECPSI)
org: School of the Art Institute of Chicago
what_you_do: Intensive 1, 2 or 4-week summer art and design courses at SAIC. Students earn one college credit for each week attended.
deadline_text: Page says registration opens November 1 (year not stated; (year inferred from the next cycle)). The 2026 sessions ran June 15 to July 31. A priority deadline is mentioned but not dated on the program page.

name: Steppenwolf Young Adult Council
what_you_do: 30 high school students meet every Wednesday to learn how a big theater works. They see plays, join workshops with theater artists, and plan teen nights with the ensemble.
deadline_text: Page says applications are closed. Next dates not posted.

name: Chicago Summer Business Institute (CSBI) Summer Internship
what_you_do: Six-week summer internship. Interns must commit to the daily requirements, but the pages do not describe them or list the job sites. A former intern's profile mentions tasks such as filing and spreadsheet work. Contact the office for placement details.
deadline_text: The portal is open Feb 1 to Mar 31 (the page gives no year but names the 2027 summer program, so expect Feb 1 to Mar 31, 2027).

name: CPS-UChicago Program
org: University of Chicago with Chicago Public Schools
what_you_do: Advanced CPS juniors and seniors take one college class each quarter at the University of Chicago. They sit in class with UChicago students. The classes go on the CPS transcript.
deadline_text: For 2026-27 the application opened June 8, 2026 and closed July 15, 2026. 2027-28 dates not posted.

name: Chicago EYES on Cancer
org: University of Chicago Medicine Comprehensive Cancer Center
what_you_do: Students work full time in a University of Chicago cancer research lab for two summers. They also get monthly career workshops, talks and mentors. They present at a research event.
grades: High school sophomore, junior or senior (or college freshman or sophomore)
deadline_text: Application and two recommendations due Nov 30, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. CT. In-person interviews Jan 4, 2027.

name: Healthcare Experience and Research in Oncology (HERO)
org: University of Chicago Medicine Comprehensive Cancer Center
what_you_do: A two-week online program where high school students work on a cancer genetics project and a patient case study, hear daily faculty talks and build skills. Students get a home lab kit.
deadline_text: Application and two recommendations due Mar 1, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. CT. Interviews in April 2027.

name: UChicago Medicine student volunteer program
what_you_do: Student volunteers help patients, families and visitors in the hospital. They welcome people and visit with patients. They help families find their way. Roles include Child Life and patient comfort teams.
grades: High school, college and graduate students
deadline_text: Fall window ran Aug 25 to Oct 1, 2026 (may close early). Next cycle starts Jan 10, 2027; closing date not posted.

name: researcHStart
org: University of Chicago Medicine Comprehensive Cancer Center with UIC, UIUC, Northwestern and Rush
what_you_do: High school students spend 8 weeks in a cancer research lab. They work 35 to 40 hours a week. The lab is at one of five Illinois universities. Students also get career workshops and mentors.
grades: High school junior or senior at time of application
deadline_text: Application and two recommendations due Jan 11, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. CT. On-campus interviews in February 2027; acceptance notices March 1, 2027.

name: University of Chicago Summer Session pre-college programs
what_you_do: High school students take college-level courses in person (live on campus or commute) or online. Choices run from short programs to research courses. Examples are lab biology or fieldwork with Field Museum fossil experts.
grades: High school (programs open depend on your current grade)
deadline_text: 2026 deadlines: priority Feb 11, regular Mar 12 (Practicum priority only). 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Entering grades 10, 11 or 12 (from the Tech and AI day page)
name: UIC Business high school summer days (Accounting, Finance, Tech and AI, Marketing)
org: University of Illinois Chicago, College of Business Administration
city: UIC, 601 S. Morgan St., Chicago, IL
what_you_do: Spend a day on campus in a business area. The Finance Day had a trading game, a student panel and a stock pitch contest. Other days cover accounting, tech and AI, and marketing.
deadline_text: The 2026 programs ran June 23 to 26, 2026 and registration was full and closed. The page does not say if they will run again.

name: Windy City Harvest Youth Farm
org: Chicago Botanic Garden, Windy City Harvest, with After School Matters
what_you_do: Teens grow food on urban farms, tend beehives, cook with what they grow, and sell it at farm stands and markets. They build leadership and job skills and explore careers in food and farming.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

name: Chicago Youth Works (formerly One Summer Chicago): summer jobs
org: City of Chicago Dept. of Family and Support Services
what_you_do: The City runs a summer youth jobs program. It places young people in paid jobs. Partners include the Park District, CPS and City Colleges. Others are the Chicago Housing Authority, the Forest Preserves and Lincoln Park Zoo.
deadline_text: 2026 application ran March 10 to May 29, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect late winter or spring.

name: Chicagobility (paid summer career exploration for ages 14 and 15)
org: City of Chicago Dept. of Family and Support Services
what_you_do: This is a six-week summer program. It has workforce training, financial literacy training and career exploration. It has 120 hours of activities. You make a resume. You sign up for direct deposit.
deadline_text: The 2026 Chicago Youth Works application (which covers 14 to 24 year olds) ran March 10 to May 29, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Junior Ambassador Program (high school volunteers)
what_you_do: You serve patients and visitors. You support hospital staff. You explore health care careers. You work one 4 hour shift each week.
deadline_text: Three cycles a year: summer apply by April 30, fall by August 30, spring by December 30. The page lists month and day only, no year.

name: 10x10 Teen Volunteer Team (Cincinnati Art Museum)
what_you_do: Help plan the 10x10 Teen Art Expo, a week long exhibition of more than 100 teen artists from the greater Cincinnati region. The team picks the theme that artists use for their 10 by 10 inch pieces and meets monthly.
deadline_text: Volunteer applications for the 2026 to 27 team were due Friday September 4, 2026, with replies by September 11. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: Teen Workforce Development (Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Cincinnati)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Cincinnati
what_you_do: Join the Clubs' teen Workforce Development programming. You explore careers with local businesses. You also explore careers with universities, trades and the military. You learn about money. You get ready for jobs. Driver's education is part of it too.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Enroll through the Club member portal.

name: C-YA Teen Council
what_you_do: You join monthly workshops with local artists, tour the museum behind the scenes, and plan a CAC-sponsored teen event. You also post on the teen Instagram account.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 enrollment deadline was July 11. The next deadline is not posted.

name: CCM Prep Ballet Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: A one week summer ballet program. You work on ballet skills, pointe and modern dance. You also take classes on avoiding injury, healthy eating and pilates.
deadline_text: Registration opens in January 2027. A closing date is not stated on the page.

name: CCM Prep Musical Theatre Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: You train in singing, dance and acting. Teachers from the conservatory and local pros lead you. Pick a 1 week or 2 week summer session.
deadline_text: Auditions opened Oct 1, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 15, 2027. Final deadline March 1, 2027.

name: CCM Prep Strings Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: A one week summer program for high school string players. You play in small groups and a string orchestra. You learn from pros in master classes. It ends with a concert.
deadline_text: Auditions opened Oct 1, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 15, 2027. Final deadline March 15, 2027.

name: High School Summer Immersion Program
what_you_do: A one month summer program. You learn by doing and grow work skills with experts across the hospital. It replaces the earlier paid summer internship.
deadline_text: Online application opens Nov 1 and closes Feb 1, for summer 2027.

name: High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You complete tasks under hospital staff supervision. This is in the pediatric setting. You work a 2 to 3 hour shift each week. You build teamwork and leadership skills.
deadline_text: The deadline for the Summer 2026 session has passed. The page says the summer application is usually posted in January, with about two months to finish the packet.

name: CPS EDGE Internship
what_you_do: You work on a district team that matches your career goals for 6 to 8 weeks, for example facilities or communications. You shadow staff, do real tasks and tour school sites.
deadline_text: No application dates are given on the program page.

name: Aquatics Jobs: Lifeguard and Pool Staff
what_you_do: You can work part-time or seasonal jobs at Cincinnati public pools. Lifeguards keep pool users safe. Gate and pool monitors handle customer service. They also watch behavior around the pool.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page. A 2026 lifeguard screening registration form is linked.

name: Youth to Work (Y2WK) Summer Jobs
what_you_do: You work a summer job with City departments or nonprofit partners. Examples include recreation centers, pools, parks, fire and police cadets. There are workshops on workplace etiquette and basic work skills.
deadline_text: The program page says the application is usually available February to March. In 2026 the deadline passed in March (WVXU reported about two weeks left on March 10, 2026). 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Teen Volunteers (Great Parks of Hamilton County)
what_you_do: Volunteer long term in parks. Jobs include habitat restoration, education programs and special events. You can work on golf course upkeep. You can grow native plants or garden. You can also care for animals. Role training and uniforms are provided.
deadline_text: Long term volunteer information sessions have ended for 2026. Great Parks says it will host them again in March 2027.

name: Hamilton County Youth Employment Program
org: Hamilton County Job and Family Services
what_you_do: You get a paid job and job training all year. Training covers resumes, interviews, work habits, customer service and solving problems.
deadline_text: The county page has a Youth Apply Here link and no closing date. Summer slots can fill early, so apply in winter.

name: Library Volunteer Opportunities (ages 12+)
what_you_do: You can volunteer at the Main Library or a branch. You can help with kids and teen events. You can also help with holds, clerical work, technology help and tutoring.
deadline_text: The library volunteer system says it is accepting new volunteer applications. No deadline is posted.

name: Youth Programs Volunteers
what_you_do: Greet visitors, help guests find their way and cover the museums' gallery spaces, working with museum teams. Teens set their own shifts and can stay until they graduate.
deadline_text: Youth volunteers are recruited each year from January through March. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Youth Volunteer Opportunities (Cincinnati Nature Center)
what_you_do: Help collect data on the maple trees in the sugarbush during maple season. Help tidy the grounds in early spring. Teens ages 14 to 17 can also be Leaders in Training. They help camp counselors, including on nature hikes.
deadline_text: The volunteer page says recruiting and onboarding is closed for the 2026 season and to check back in the new year for 2027 dates.

name: Green Team Youth Summer Jobs
org: Groundwork Ohio River Valley with Cincinnati Parks
what_you_do: You improve and maintain trails, parks and community spaces. You remove invasive plants. You learn job readiness and natural resource skills. These skills help in the green industry.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the program pages. The City post is undated.

grades: Showcases: entering grades 6 to 12. Academies: entering grades 1 to 6 or 6 to 12
name: Performance Academies and Showcases (Cincinnati Playhouse summer theatre camp)
what_you_do: Two week academies put on a whole play or musical. One week showcases build stage skills, with a focus on acting and telling stories.
deadline_text: The program page listed 2026 camps with an early bird discount through Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Cincinnati Police Summer Cadet Program
what_you_do: You work part time over the summer for the Cincinnati Police Department and learn about police work. The page says it gives help to people who may choose police work as a career.
deadline_text: No current dates are posted on the police page. A January 2024 city news item said the 2024 police cadet application had its own deadline, so check in winter.

name: Job Shadowing (TriHealth)
what_you_do: Follow a TriHealth staff member for a short look at the job. It is usually about 8 to 16 hours. Shadowing is observation only. You cannot talk with patients in a hands-on way or see their medical records.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are posted. Check with the program.

name: UC Summer Engineering Camps (Young and Rising Engineers)
org: University of Cincinnati College of Engineering and Applied Science
what_you_do: Day camps on the Clifton campus from 9 am to 4 pm. Camps are organized by age and interest level.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed and late applications were not accepted. Sign up for the interest list to hear about 2027 camps.

name: Early IT Summer Camp (University of Cincinnati)
org: University of Cincinnati School of Information Technology
what_you_do: Attend a free day camp. Learn cybersecurity, software development, game development and data and cloud technologies. Hear from IT leaders. Build a team project with a college student mentor.
deadline_text: The camp page has a Registration is Now Open notice for June 1 to 18, Monday to Friday. Spots are first come, first served. The page shows no year and no closing date, so a teen cannot tell which summer it means. The registration notice may be from a past year: the same page still links an Early IT Summer Camp 2023 Application. Email ucearlyit@ucmail.uc.edu to confirm the year before applying.

name: Career Journeys Program (UC Medical Center)
what_you_do: You learn what hospital jobs are like, both with patients and behind the scenes. You hear from staff, go on tours and join online sessions.
deadline_text: The page links an online application and gives no deadline.

name: UC Health Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors, work in waiting rooms and clinics, and do other tasks such as the gift shop. At least 4 hours a week.
deadline_text: UC Medical Center summer applications run April 1 to 30. West Chester summer applications run April 1 to 30; fall applications start in August and spring applications start in December.

name: Medical Sciences Summer Institute (University of Cincinnati)
org: University of Cincinnati College of Medicine
what_you_do: Take a week long, full day workshop at the UC College of Medicine. It is for rising high school juniors and seniors. They should be interested in medicine or health care. Tracks are Cellular or Molecular, plus one Medical Informatics session.
grades: Rising high school juniors and seniors
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was March 25, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program (Urban Champions)
org: Urban League of Greater Southwestern Ohio
what_you_do: You work a summer job that teaches responsibility and career readiness. The league also runs a yearly youth summit led by teens.
deadline_text: The page has an Apply Now button and no dates. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.

name: ZooTeen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You volunteer at the Zoo for the summer. This includes one week of ZooTeen camp. It also includes Visitor Engagement shifts. You also join Lunch and Learns and events.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application is open online Dec 1, 2026 to Jan 31, 2027. Information sessions Nov 16, Dec 14 and Jan 11 (6 to 7 p.m.). Group interviews Feb 27, Feb 28, Mar 13 or Mar 14. Decisions by email April 2, 2027.

name: Teen Volunteering at Bexley Public Library
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the library. Youth Department volunteers pull books and prep crafts. Program volunteers can serve as reading buddies for Page Pals.
deadline_text: The page says the teen volunteer program is currently full and that applications for summer volunteering will open April 1. No year is shown.

name: Youth Advisory Council (health grants)
what_you_do: You learn how giving money for health works. You help pick which youth health programs get grants. Topics include mental health, bullying, basic needs and drug use prevention.
deadline_text: The page posts no deadline and does not say whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. It does not confirm 2026-2027 membership.

name: College Credit Plus at Columbus State
what_you_do: Take real college classes at Columbus State while you are in grades 7 to 12. You earn college credit and meet high school graduation rules at the same time.
deadline_text: Public school students must submit a Letter of Intent to their high school by April 1. Homeschool and non-public students apply for state CCP funding by April 1. The page does not state the year of the next deadline.

name: Ready 2 Earn (Franklin County summer youth jobs)
org: Franklin County Job and Family Services with partner nonprofits
what_you_do: Partner groups run summer work programs. Ages 14 to 15 do a 6-week program. Ages 16 to 18 get traditional work experiences. Ages 18 to 21 do paid pre-apprenticeship training.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications were listed as full at every partner. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.

name: Godman Guild Youth and Young Adult Workforce Program
what_you_do: You explore careers and practice resumes and interviews. You build leadership and money skills. The summer Ready 2 Earn part has coaching, projects and an AI certificate.
deadline_text: The page has a Youth and Young Adult Workforce Program interest form but does not say whether it is open now or has a deadline. Monthly events run from Nov 18, 2026 to May 6, 2027. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Volunteer Program (teen volunteers ages 16 and 17)
what_you_do: Help care for shelter animals or help with non-animal tasks after training. Volunteers commit to at least 4 hours a month.
deadline_text: The page gives no registration deadline and does not say when sign-ups open.

name: Summer Reading Challenge VolunTeen
what_you_do: You help library customers sign up for the Summer Reading Challenge. You log reading points. You hand out prizes. You help with programs at a branch.
deadline_text: 2026: application opened April 13 at 3 p.m. and the program ran June 1 to July 31. 2027 dates are not posted. The library's regular volunteer application for Fall 2026 opened August 10.

name: Metro Parks Volunteer Program (Junior Volunteers at Inniswood)
what_you_do: Volunteer in central Ohio parks, for example as a naturalist, trail volunteer or on wildlife projects. Junior Volunteers at Inniswood Metro Gardens help with flowerbeds and children's programs.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Volunteer Information sessions are held twice a year; the Inniswood training is held in March.

name: Volunteer with Mid-Ohio Food Collective
what_you_do: Sort and pack food, help serve in the Mid-Ohio Kitchen, work at the markets or garden, or make kids' meals. Groups and friends can sign up together.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for open shifts any time.

name: Mount Carmel Health Teen Program (volunteer)
what_you_do: You volunteer one shift a week at a Mount Carmel hospital. You help patients and visitors. Jobs depend on the hospital and when you can come.
deadline_text: The Teen Program runs year-round. No deadline is listed.

name: CMA//Next Teen Program
what_you_do: You go behind the scenes at the museum and explore modern art. You work with staff to make programs for young people. You also build work skills and learn to speak to the public.
deadline_text: The application for the 2026-27 session has closed. The page says to stay tuned for future opportunities and gives no new dates.

name: Teen Studio (free, ages 13 to 19)
what_you_do: A free, teens-only art workshop at the museum with snacks. A quarterly version called Teen Studio: Unwind is also offered.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Specific dates for Unwind are not listed on the program page.

name: Teen Volunteering at Nationwide Children's Hospital (summer)
what_you_do: Help families, patients and staff under supervision at the hospital. You keep one weekly 2 to 3 hour shift from June to mid-August and can move into new assignments if you do well.
deadline_text: The 2026 application opened February 2, 2026 and has reached capacity. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: OhioHealth hospital volunteers
what_you_do: Help patients, families and staff at an OhioHealth hospital. You might guide guests, help when patients go home, stock patient rooms or do office work.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. At Riverside Methodist, the steps from applying to starting take 6 to 8 weeks.

name: STEM Institute (Ohio Supercomputer Center)
what_you_do: A 2 week camp where you live on campus. You work in small teams and use supercomputers to solve science and engineering problems. Talks cover Unix, Python, cyber safety and supercomputers. You tour Ohio State labs.
deadline_text: Applications open January 15 and close April 1, 2027. Accepted students are told in April.

grades: Entering 10 to 12 for high school courses (7 to 9 for middle school courses)
name: Arts and Sciences Summer Exploration Program
org: The Ohio State University College of Arts and Sciences
what_you_do: You take a one-week course on campus, taught by Ohio State faculty, staff and graduate students. Classes meet 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Monday to Friday and are not for grades or credit.
deadline_text: Check back in early January 2027 for the summer 2027 course list and registration form.

name: HRS Camp (Health and Rehabilitation Sciences, Ohio State)
org: School of Health and Rehabilitation Sciences, The Ohio State University
what_you_do: A three-day hands-on camp with practice drills. You visit an anatomy lab and practice what to do in a code blue. You listen to heart and lung sounds and practice intubation. You also try a surgery skills lab and see brain activity demos.
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran June 1 to 3, 2026. The page lists an April 24 deadline (no year given, matching the 2026 dates), decisions April 27 to May 8, and orientation May 28. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Humanities and Cognitive Sciences Summer Institute (HumCog)
org: Center for Cognitive and Brain Sciences, The Ohio State University
what_you_do: A one-week day program. Mornings are lectures by Ohio State professors on the mind and brain. Afternoons are group talks and hands-on activities. You also get a taste of college life.
deadline_text: 2026 program ran July 13 to 17, 2026. All 2026 materials were due May 31, 2026, with decisions by June 14. The page says to check back in February 2027 for the next application.

name: MD Camp at Ohio State
org: The Ohio State University College of Medicine
what_you_do: A three-week day camp that gives you a taste of med school. You hear lectures and learn the basics of research. You do a service project and clinical workshops. You also shadow doctors at Wexner Medical Center and Nationwide Children's Hospital.
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran June 8 to 26, 2026. 2026 applications were due March 17, 2026 (late ones not accepted). 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Ohio State Wexner Medical Center K-12 health care career exploration
org: The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center
what_you_do: Your school can ask for health care career visits. Staff can come to class, talk by phone, or host a field trip. Some schools can also set up job shadow days and internships in fields like nursing and lab work.
deadline_text: Student experiences run during the school year only. Schools should send requests at least 60 days ahead.

name: Young Scholars Program (Ohio State)
org: The Ohio State University Office of Undergraduate Education
what_you_do: You get college advice, coaching, mentors and campus visits from 8th grade through high school. Students who finish in good standing get an Ohio State money package for college.
deadline_text: The page says applications are accepted from prospective 8th graders each year. The 2026-27 deadline is not stated on the part of the program page.

name: Student Volunteers at Pickerington Public Library
what_you_do: Help keep the library neat, put books on shelves and set up events. You can help at the Homework Help Center and reward readers during Summer Reading. There is more to do too.
deadline_text: The page lists no volunteer application deadline and does not say whether applications are accepted year-round.

name: APPS Job Readiness Program
what_you_do: You do paid work with City departments and local businesses. Jobs can include helping at summer camps, caring for parks or supporting golf courses. You get mentoring, skill building and career planning.
deadline_text: 2026 participant applications ran Feb 2 to Feb 17, 2026 and are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: City Leaders Academy
what_you_do: You learn leadership, teamwork, problem solving and service. You meet monthly from fall to spring. A family orientation is required. There is an end-of-year ceremony.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due 5 p.m. Wednesday, July 1, 2026. 2027-28 dates are not posted.

name: Seasonal Lifeguard
what_you_do: Lifeguard jobs are open now. The jobs are seasonal.
deadline_text: The City says it is currently hiring lifeguards for seasonal positions. The page gives no closing date and no season dates.

name: Ross Mathematics Program (Otterbein University site)
what_you_do: A six week summer program in math where you live on campus.
deadline_text: The summer 2026 application window has closed. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: TECH CORPS Computing Career Corps and IT On Ramp+
what_you_do: Computing Career Corps is a hands-on way to try key tech skills. IT On Ramp+ is a four week, full day program. It builds algebra and geometry skills and confidence.
deadline_text: The page lists IT On Ramp+ sessions June 1 to 26 at Whitehall-Yearling High School and July 6 to 31 at Franklin Heights High School. The page gives no year. Dates for 2027 are not posted.

name: Summer Writing Camp Interns
what_you_do: Work in the summer writing camp for campers in grades 2 to 9. The camp has eight camp weeks. You work at least one week. The page names clean-up after camp as an intern task.
deadline_text: The page does not post an application deadline or interview dates. Contact Meg Brown by email.

name: Teen Summer Writing Intensive
what_you_do: A two-week day camp where teens write stories, poems and dialogue with working writers and teachers, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at the Thurber Center and Thurber House downtown.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed July 6, 2026. The page says to check back in the new year for 2027 information.

name: Young Writers' Studio (teens, grades 9 to 12)
what_you_do: Teens meet every other Tuesday evening to do writing exercises and share and discuss their own writing. You can join in person or by Zoom.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 sessions are on Tuesdays: Sep 1, Sep 15 and Sep 29 have passed. Oct 13, Oct 27 and Nov 10, 2026 are still ahead. The page has a Register button but no deadline and no closed notice. It does not say whether you can still join mid-season, so check with Thurber House before you plan on it.

name: Teen Volunteering at Upper Arlington Public Library
what_you_do: Teens help with craft kits, library programs and cleaning toys during the school year, and help at the Summer Reading prize table in summer. Teen Service Club sessions earn one hour of service credit.
deadline_text: School-year 2026-2027 teen volunteering is listed as open. The page does not list summer 2027 dates. Teen Service Club dates run from October 19, 2026 into 2027, with registration opening 2 weeks before each date.

name: Work Readiness Training University (WRTU)
what_you_do: You take part in a paid summer youth internship program. It builds empowerment, innovation, high performance and civic engagement skills. Employer partners help run it.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the program page.

name: Teen Volunteer Programs (Westerville Public Library)
what_you_do: Teens earn service hours by helping library staff. There are two roles. Summer Volunteers give out prizes and help kids sign up to read. Lead Volunteers help at events and get materials ready.
deadline_text: Summer Volunteers (ages 12 to 18, May to July) is marked not yet accepting applications. Lead Volunteers (ages 16 to 18) is marked currently full. The page gives no year. Call 614-882-7277, option 5, to ask when applications open.

name: Volunteens (teen volunteers)
what_you_do: In the school year, sort and shelve materials and help with program supplies and office work. In summer, help patrons join the Summer Reading Club and do special projects.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The page was last revised August 18, 2026.

name: Teen Leaders Club (Hilliard YMCA)
what_you_do: You build leadership skills by volunteering. You plan events like blood drives and weekend retreats. You can also join counselor in training programs.
deadline_text: New members are always welcome. No deadline is posted.

grades: Sophomores, juniors and seniors in high school
name: Oceans and You: Bahamas Field Study (Teen Conservation Travel)
city: Columbus, OH (trip to Andros Island, Bahamas)
what_you_do: An 8-day trip to the Forfar Field Station in the Bahamas with Zoo staff. You study the sea and how to protect it. You snorkel, explore tide pools, and learn about climate change, plastics and jobs in conservation.
deadline_text: Apply by November 22, 2026. Info sessions: in person Nov. 11, 2026 and virtual Nov. 12, 2026 (6:30 to 7:30 p.m.). The Zoo tells students if they were selected by December 4, 2026.

grades: High school (a faculty advisor is required)
name: Teen Eco Summit
what_you_do: A school team of 4 to 7 high school students plus one advisor spends a kickoff day at the Zoo. The team then builds a Conservation Action Plan for its school or town. It shares the plan at a spring celebration. Teams can apply for grant money.
deadline_text: The application deadline was October 1, 2026. The page does not post a 2027-28 round.

name: ZooAide Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help guests and learn about conservation careers, with an emphasis on zoo and aquarium customer service. Direct animal contact is minimal.
deadline_text: The 2026 season application has ended. The page says 2027 ZooAide applications will be posted in early 2027.

name: Forest Preserve Experience
org: Friends of the Forest Preserves, Forest Preserves of Cook County and the Housing Authority of Cook County
what_you_do: A paid summer job on a crew of 12 teens. You remove invasive plants, pick up litter and clean rivers and lakes in your local forest preserve. You also learn job skills and go on field trips and canoe outings.
deadline_text: Last cycle the Housing Authority sent application materials in early March and applications closed April 30. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Chicago Conservation Leadership Corps (CCLC)
org: Forest Preserves of Cook County with the Student Conservation Association
what_you_do: A paid summer crew job outdoors in the forest preserves. Teens build trails, spread mulch around trees and pull invasive plants, with adult crew leaders. There are also nature lessons and outdoor fun.
deadline_text: Forest Preserves page: youth applications are due in April. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Youth Outdoor Ambassador Program
what_you_do: A paid summer internship in the Forest Preserves. You pull invasive plants, care for animals, help at events and help naturalists run kids' nature camps. Weekly field trips show you green careers.
deadline_text: Applications usually open in early February and are due by the end of March. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Opportunity Works (subsidized internships and training)
org: Cook County Office of the President and Chicago Cook Workforce Partnership
what_you_do: Young people who are not working or in school get a paid internship and training. The fields are trucking and shipping, computers, or making things.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline stated on the page.

grades: Teen Tech Tutors and Local History: grades 9 to 12. Summer volunteers: grades 7 to 12. Service crafts and T(w)een board: grades 6 to 8.
name: Teen Volunteers: Tech Tutors, Local History and Summer Volunteers
city: Libertyville and Vernon Hills, IL (Lake County)
what_you_do: Give one-on-one tech help as a Teen Tech Tutor, help with local history work like photocopying and data entry, or volunteer in the summer. Younger teens can do service craft programs or join a T(w)een Advisory Board. Volunteer work counts as service hours.
deadline_text: Local History Assistant (grades 9 to 12) takes applications with no deadline. Teen Tech Tutor closed Oct 15, 2026. Summer 2026 and Seed Library roles are closed.

name: Youth Volunteer Program (ages 13+)
what_you_do: You greet guests. You also help COSI educators as an operational volunteer. First you apply and do an interview. Then you finish three weekend training sessions.
deadline_text: 2026 window: applications Aug 1 to Aug 15, interviews Sept 15, 16 or 17, decisions Sept 30, trainings Oct 24/25, Nov 21/22 and Dec 12/13. The 2026 youth window is closed; no 2027 youth dates. Adult applications open January 2027.

name: Chicago Public Library paid summer teen internships
org: Chicago Public Library with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help patrons at a library branch. They promote summer programs. They organize spaces and make book lists. Then they co-lead a library program. In 2026, interns were also trained to lead Artist's Studio in the Library with the Art Institute.
deadline_text: The 2026 posting says applications are closed. 2027 dates not posted; the Chicago Youth Works summer application ran March 10 to May 29 in 2026.

name: Chicago Public Library teen assistantships (Teen Best Reads, Teen Gamer's Guild, Teen Media Lab)
org: Chicago Public Library with After School Matters
what_you_do: These are paid teen assistantships at the library. You pick and promote the year's best teen books. Or you plan a free gaming convention. Or you make social media content in YOUmedia. Teens meet weekly or monthly and finish projects.
deadline_text: Applications open Monday Oct 19, 2026 and close Sunday Nov 8, 2026.

name: CPS Career and Technical Education (CTE) pathways
what_you_do: You can take career classes in 11 areas. Areas include farm science, construction and business. They also include cooking, teaching and health. Others are IT, law and safety, manufacturing, media, personal care and transportation. You get hands-on learning.
deadline_text: GoCPS high school application dates are not stated on the CTE page; check GoCPS.

name: Chicago Builds (CPS construction pre-apprenticeship)
what_you_do: This two-year training program is for CPS juniors and seniors. You rotate through carpentry, electricity, HVAC and welding. You earn OSHA 10, CPR and NCCER credentials. In senior year, you do internships. You also prepare for the pre-apprenticeship exam.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed April 17, 2026 (decisions by May 22). 2027-28 dates not posted.

name: CPS Cooperative Education (senior-year work study)
what_you_do: Seniors spend the afternoon of a school day at a paid job or internship. It lasts all year. The job matches a career path. You get a personal training plan. A co-op teacher visits the worksite.
deadline_text: Students must apply during junior year. Application dates not stated on the page.

name: CPS Early College: dual credit and dual enrollment at City Colleges of Chicago
org: Chicago Public Schools and City Colleges of Chicago
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take college courses for free. Take them at their own high school (dual credit). Or take them on a City Colleges campus (dual enrollment). Career courses include aviation, construction, culinary, IT and nursing.
deadline_text: Register once per academic year. Deadlines not stated; talk to your counselor early.

name: Chicago Police and Firefighter Training Academy (CPFTA)
org: Chicago Public Schools with Chicago Police, Fire and City Colleges
what_you_do: This two-year after-school program is for juniors and seniors. You apply as a sophomore. Classes meet twice a week at the Police or Fire Academy. Qualified students can earn OSHA, CPR and EMT-B certifications. It leads to a path into City Colleges.
grades: Apply in 10th grade; program runs 11th and 12th grade
deadline_text: The application for the class of 2028 is closed. Sophomores apply online each year beginning in February; recruitment events run in February and March. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Lyman Woods Volunteers (camp and program helpers, ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Help the camp counselor and campers with games, crafts and hikes at Lyman Woods. You can also help at after-school and special programs. Other roles are restoration and garden work. There is also an office role at the interpretive center.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Call 630-963-9388 for Lyman Woods volunteer details.

grades: Junior program: junior high students. Teen/adult program: 14 or entering high school.
name: Teen and Junior Volunteers
what_you_do: Help kids and families at the children's museum. Teen volunteers (14 and up) take flexible shifts. Junior volunteers (junior high) help one weekend day a week for three months.
deadline_text: Junior volunteers are recruited in September and January. Teen and adult openings are posted on the museum site.

name: Volunteer Programs (teen openings)
org: Forest Preserve District of DuPage County
what_you_do: Volunteer in the forest preserves. Jobs include one-time restoration workdays and special events. You can also help at nature centers, farms and historic sites. Teens 13 to 17 have a few long-term roles.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Some roles have deadlines and limited space. New volunteer orientation is held monthly at district headquarters (second Wednesday evening).

name: Elgin Community College Dual Credit
what_you_do: You can take college courses at Elgin Community College. You can also take them at your high school. You earn high school and college credit at the same time. Options include general education and career tech courses.
deadline_text: No deadline on the ECC page. Talk with your high school counselor about dates.

name: Educational Talent Search
what_you_do: Get help planning for college and careers. You choose classes, explore careers, set goals and prep for tests. You get help with college and aid forms. There are college tours and workshops for parents.
deadline_text: No deadline. Spots are first come, first served, so apply as early as possible.

name: Upward Bound at Elgin Community College
what_you_do: This is free college prep for high school students. It includes advising, educational workshops and tutoring. It also includes field trips and college courses. You get fee waivers for college applications and SAT/ACT.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page.

name: Elgin Fire Department Explorer Post 439
what_you_do: Learn firefighter and paramedic skills in class and hands-on. Topics include CPR, first aid, fitness, breathing gear, search and rescue and fire fighting. Help at community events. Uniform and gear are provided.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Come to a meeting (1st or 3rd Wednesday at 6:00 p.m.) to get an application.

name: Hawthorne Hill Nature Center Volunteers
org: City of Elgin Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Help at the nature center. Tasks include greeting visitors, office work, planting native plants and removing invasive plants. You can also care for trails, lead bird walks, watch wildlife and help with programs. Staff train you.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Elgin Police Explorer Post 1445
what_you_do: Train each week in court rules, CPR and crime prevention. You also learn to collect evidence and patrol. Help the police at special events. Do fingerprinting at community events and open houses.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted twice a year. Dates are not posted. Email hector.gutierrez@elginil.gov or edwin.alva@elginil.gov for the next opening.

name: Elgin Teen Life
org: Elgin Police Department and Gail Borden Public Library
what_you_do: Join a monthly activity with Elgin police officers. Each month brings a different fun activity. Teens and officers get to know each other.
deadline_text: No deadline. Watch the calendar and social media for dates.

name: School District U-46 Career and Technical Education pathways
what_you_do: Take a set of career classes in high school. Areas include business, health care, building and design, tech, and cooking and family life. Some classes add job training, real work time or college credit.
deadline_text: No application for Educational Pathways. Pick classes with your counselor when you plan your schedule.

name: School District U-46 High School Magnet Academies
what_you_do: A four-year high school program at one U-46 high school: STEM at Bartlett, IB at Elgin, arts at Larkin, media and digital arts at South Elgin, or leadership and design at Streamwood.
deadline_text: Application open Oct 1 to Oct 31, 2026, for fall 2027. The lottery runs Nov 9, 2026, and results are emailed that evening.

grades: Volunteering and the Reading Program: grade 6 and up. Junior Teen Advisory Group: grades 6 to 8.
name: Volunteering, Service Hours and Junior Teen Advisory Group
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library or earn service hours. The Junior Teen Advisory Group does service projects and creates teen programs. It also gives book talks, makes promo videos and goes on field trips.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Reading Program volunteer details are announced in January.

name: Student Volunteer Program at Edward Hospital
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital as a student volunteer. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The student form says more students apply than there are spots.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Elmhurst Hospital
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital as a teen volunteer, for example as a greeter or in the gift shop. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: The main volunteer page lists a teen application for this hospital. It does not give dates or say whether applications are open.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Evanston Hospital
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Other departments need help too. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: The main volunteer page lists a teen application for this hospital. It does not give dates or say whether applications are open. It also lists a summer application.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Glenbrook Hospital
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Other departments need help too. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: The main volunteer page lists a teen application for this hospital. It does not give dates or say whether applications are open. It also lists a summer application.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Highland Park Hospital
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Other departments need help too. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: The main volunteer page lists a teen application for this hospital. It does not give dates or say whether applications are open. It also lists a summer application.

name: High School Volunteer Program at Northwest Community Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital for at least six months. You help patients, visitors and staff. After an interview, you get a role that fits you.
deadline_text: The main volunteer page lists a teen application for this hospital. It does not give dates or say whether applications are open.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Skokie Hospital
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Other departments need help too. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: The main volunteer page lists a teen application for this hospital. It does not give dates or say whether applications are open. It also lists a summer application.

name: Teen Board at the Evanston Art Center
what_you_do: Be a teen ambassador for the art center. Plan and lead 2 to 3 community art events. Meet artists who work today. Earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: The page says "APPLICATIONS ARE CURRENTLY OPEN!" but gives no closing date. Its board photo is captioned 2023-24.

name: ASPIRE Evanston: Careers in Healthcare
org: City of Evanston with Endeavor Health, Evanston Township High School and Oakton Community College
what_you_do: Job shadow and do a paid summer internship in health care. You can also earn a credential at Oakton Community College. You may qualify for an ASPIRE scholarship.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the program pages.

name: Work-Based Learning at Evanston Township High School
what_you_do: Join career mentorships, internships, job shadowing, practicums and service learning set up by the school. Internships can be paid or unpaid and last from a few weeks to a year.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Contact the Early College and Career Experiences office.

name: Mayor's Summer Youth Employment Program (MSYEP)
org: City of Evanston Youth and Young Adult Division
what_you_do: Work up to nine weeks in an entry level summer job with a city department, a community group or a business. A job fair is where youth meet employers.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: youth had to register ahead for the job fair on Saturday, February 28, 2026 (9 a.m. to 2 p.m., Robert Crown Community Center). 2027 dates are not posted yet.

grades: Rising high school senior (senior in 2027-28) or 2027 high school graduate
name: Fermilab PRISM (Program for Research, Innovation, and STEM Mentorship)
what_you_do: This is a four-week summer program. You explore STEM fields at Fermilab. You connect with Fermilab STEM professionals. The schedule has both on-site and off-site parts.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 12, 2027 and close Mar 1, 2027 (recommendation letter also due Mar 1). Offers Apr 12, 2027; accept by Apr 21, 2027.

name: Saturday Morning Physics
what_you_do: Go to a free series of 11 Saturday morning talks and tours on modern physics. Topics include particle physics and quantum computing. You do not need a science background.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed and the session is full. The Spring 2027 session will be announced in November. The program announces fall in May and spring in November.

name: Saturday Morning Quantum* in Chicago
what_you_do: Take a free 10 class series on quantum science and engineering. Experts lead it. It shows you Fermilab careers and may include tours of Fermilab. Finishing can help with future internships and college portfolios.
deadline_text: Applications for Spring 2027 will open in late fall 2026. Classes run February 6 to April 24, 2027.

grades: Illinois JROTC high school junior, senior or recent graduate
name: Fermilab VALOR JROTC Summer Internship
what_you_do: This is a six-week paid summer internship at Fermilab. Illinois JROTC cadets get hands-on technical training. It is in person in Batavia.
deadline_text: Applications opened Oct 5, 2026 and close Feb 5, 2027. Offers Mar 15, 2027; accept by Mar 22, 2027.

name: Seasonal and Part-Time Park District Jobs
what_you_do: Apply online for seasonal and part-time park district jobs. The page says positions range from teens seeking a first job to highly skilled professionals.
deadline_text: Postings go up through the year. The district holds an annual job fair in late winter. Past press releases gave Saturday, Feb. 22 (posted February 18, 2020, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., Prisco Community Center) and Saturday, March 11 (posted February 24, 2023, 9 a.m. to noon, Prisco). 2027 date not posted.

grades: Middle school, high school and college students
name: Volunteer Opportunities for Teens and School Groups
what_you_do: Join park clean-ups, adopt a park or trail, and help at events. The district welcomes middle school, high school and college students and school clubs, and says the hours can count toward service requirements.
deadline_text: No deadline. The Fall Day of Service on October 3, 2026 has passed. Adopt-A-Park runs April to September (or May to October).

name: Teen Corps
org: Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens
what_you_do: You grow produce in a community garden. You sell it at the Conservatory's Farmers Market. You learn plant care, healthy eating, running a business and speaking skills.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 Teen Corps are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Conservatory Volunteer Program (age 15+)
org: Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens
what_you_do: You can help the horticulture, education or visitor experience teams. Tasks include weeding and planting. You can also help in the Children's Garden or at the Farmers Market.
deadline_text: Opportunities are available year-round. No deadline is posted.

name: Teen Volunteers at Gail Borden Public Library
what_you_do: You help with library events. You refresh library spaces. You prepare crafts for programs. Listed sessions include Cleaning the Classics, Knitting for a Cause and Crafting for the Community.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A teen volunteer orientation is listed for Sunday, Oct 18, 1:00 to 1:30 PM at the Main Library Conference Room (the page does not print the year; Oct 18 is a Sunday in 2026).

name: Volunteens at Geneva Public Library
what_you_do: Volunteer for library tasks. After you register, the library emails sign-up sheets showing when help is needed and you choose time slots that fit your schedule.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 session runs Sept 14 to Dec 4, 2026. No registration deadline is listed. Dates for the next session are not posted.

grades: Youth volunteers: grades 6 to 12. Innovation Center: grades 9 to 12. Teen Advisory Board: grades 7 to 11.
name: Youth Volunteers, Innovation Center Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Help with children's programs as a school year youth volunteer. Or keep the Innovation Center tidy and learn its 3D printers and laser cutters. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It plans library events.
deadline_text: School year youth volunteer applications opened August 15 and no close date is stated. Returning volunteers do not need to reapply. Teen Advisory Board applications are open November 1 to 30, and new members are told December 14 (no year printed on the page).

name: STEAM Squad teen internship
what_you_do: Teen interns work in teams of three. They research and plan activities. They lead science, technology, engineering, art and math activities. These are for kids at participating libraries.
deadline_text: Hiring dates are not stated. Sign up for Hennepin County job notifications to be told about openings.

name: Teen volunteers
what_you_do: Help at a local Hennepin County library. Positions vary by library.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Ask your local library whether it has a teen opening.

name: Hoffman Estates Park District Swim Instructor (16 and up)
what_you_do: A part-time job teaching swim lessons to kids and adults at The Club at Prairie Stone. You follow lesson plans, watch swimmers closely, and tell parents how their child is doing.
deadline_text: Posted on the park district job board with no closing date. Apply while the posting is up.

name: Illinois 4-H Creative Collective Art Ambassadors
what_you_do: A one-year statewide team for teens with strong visual or performing arts skills. Members help plan arts programs, go to trainings, and lead an art booth at the Illinois State Fair and Camp Kaleido.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

name: Illinois 4-H Food Advocacy Ambassadors
what_you_do: A statewide teen team that works on food access. Members meet with food experts, plan projects, and may speak to community groups or elected officials.
deadline_text: Application due December 31, 2026.

name: Illinois 4-H Healthy Living Ambassadors
what_you_do: A statewide teen team that plans health programs and events for youth and families. Members meet monthly online, go to a team retreat, and work at the Illinois State Fair.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

name: Illinois 4-H Influencers Team
what_you_do: A team of 7 to 10 high school students who make social media content and tell stories for 4-H. They also cover events and work the PR booth at the Illinois State Fair.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

name: Speaking for Illinois 4-H
what_you_do: A one-day, hands-on public speaking training. Teens learn to tell the 4-H story to elected officials, donors and community groups, and can speak at state events like Legislative Connection.
deadline_text: Training dates are not listed on the page. Use the register link.

name: Illinois 4-H clubs and teen leadership teams
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects. Older teens can also join state teen teams, like STEM Ambassadors, Healthy Living Ambassadors or the Youth Leadership Team.
deadline_text: No sign-up deadline is posted. Teen team applications and dates are not posted on the main teen page.

grades: High school juniors (finished at least one semester of 11th grade)
name: Illinois Boys State (American Legion)
what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Young men run a mock state government on the Eastern Illinois University campus. There are scholarship contests. You also get lifelong alumni membership.
deadline_text: The registration page says registration for the 2027 session closes at 4:00 PM on June 12, 2027, when the session starts. Ask your local Legion post about its earlier sponsor deadline.

name: Illinois Education and Training Voucher (ETV) for college and training
org: Illinois Department of Children and Family Services
what_you_do: Money for college or trade school costs that other aid does not cover, such as tuition, books, supplies, transportation and a laptop. Teens in foster care can plan for it before they graduate.
deadline_text: No deadline stated in the FAQ.

name: Illinois DCFS Employment, Job Training and Apprenticeship Incentive Program
org: Illinois Department of Children and Family Services
what_you_do: A money benefit for teens in DCFS care who have a job, are in job training or are in an approved apprenticeship. It helps youth build work skills.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Illinois DECA chapters and state conference
org: Illinois DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter to practice business skills in marketing, management, entrepreneurship, hospitality and tourism, or finance. Chapters compete at an Illinois state conference each spring.
deadline_text: The Illinois DECA conference is March 4 to 6, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency O'Hare in Rosemont, IL. No membership deadline is posted.

grades: High school (also middle level and college chapters exist)
name: Illinois FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
what_you_do: Join a business club at your school. Members build leadership and business skills, compete in events, and network at local, state and national levels.
deadline_text: 2026-27 dates: State Leadership Conference Apr 9 to 10, 2027; Summer Leadership Experience Jul 29 to 31, 2027; National Leadership Conference Jun 23 to 26, 2027 in Columbus OH. Regional dates are in the calendar PDF.

name: ALA Illini Girls State (American Legion Auxiliary)
org: American Legion Auxiliary Department of Illinois
what_you_do: A week-long citizenship and leadership program for high school girls, sponsored by an American Legion Auxiliary Unit. Delegates must attend the full session.
deadline_text: Next session is June 20 to 26, 2027. There is no fixed deadline: the FAQ says applications are accepted until the program is full, so apply early.

name: Hire the Future
what_you_do: Free job help for young people. You can get help searching for jobs, getting ready for interviews and planning a career at an IDES office.
deadline_text: No deadline. Visit an IDES office any time.

name: SRELO summer research at IMSA
org: Illinois Mathematics and Science Academy (IMSA), Aurora
city: Aurora, IL (open to Illinois students statewide)
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on a research project with an IMSA faculty mentor. The 2026 projects included AI and cardiology or neuroscience, molecular modeling, Chinese history and building a game in Pygame.
deadline_text: The 2026 application portal showed closed. No 2027 dates are posted. Sessions in 2026 were in June and July.

name: ISBE Student Advisory Council
what_you_do: Research education topics that affect Illinois public school students. Meet with policymakers and community partners, then present policy ideas to the State Board of Education.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed June 30, 2026 and late applications were not considered. Finalists were emailed in July for a video interview.

name: Illinois State Fair Volunteer Program
org: Illinois State Fair, Illinois Department of Agriculture
what_you_do: Volunteers work at information booths. They greet visitors at the gates and the Expo Building. They help in the fair office or go where they are needed.
deadline_text: The 2026 fair was Aug 13 to 23. The page does not post 2027 fair dates or volunteer application dates.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Illinois Wing
what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. Squadrons meet about 2.5 hours a week plus about one Saturday a month, with summer encampments and career academies.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

name: Illinois YMCA Youth and Government
city: Springfield, IL (state conference), delegations across Illinois
what_you_do: Join a delegation and take a role in a student model of Illinois state government. Roles include legislator, attorney, lobbyist or press team. You use what you learn at a state conference.
deadline_text: The scholarship portal closed October 1, 2026 (decisions come before November 1). The program page does not say if you can still register, and it posts no general registration deadline or conference dates. Ask your Delegation Advisor or the state office before you count on a spot.

name: IMSA AI Credential (online course)
what_you_do: Take a self-paced online course on how AI works, from machine learning to robotics, and on its ethics and safety. Weekly office hours with IMSA computer science faculty. You earn a certificate.
deadline_text: The September 2026 cohort runs September 28 to December 18, 2026, and has already started. The page lists registration for September 2026 only and gives no next date. Email studentenrichment@imsa.edu to ask about the next cohort.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL

name: Research Fundamentals (online)
what_you_do: Take a self-guided online course. You plan and run a science investigation and write a science paper. It is the course you must take before the summer SRELO research program.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened January 26, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL

name: RISE: Research, Inquiry Skills and Experimentation
what_you_do: Do your own science research project in a year-long, mostly asynchronous online program. You find a mentor, write a research paper, make a poster and present at spring science symposia.
deadline_text: The page says registration opened Thursday, July 30, 2026 at noon and has a Register button. It posts no closing date and does not say if new students can still join. Spots are limited. Full refund (less the $100 fee) through mid-September 2026; no refunds after September 30, 2026. Ask IMSA before you pay.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL

name: 4-H Academy @ Purdue
what_you_do: A three-day, two-night stay in a Purdue residence hall. You pick hands-on workshops such as animal health, AI, food science, leadership and plant sciences taught by Purdue faculty and experts.
deadline_text: The 2026 conference ran June 10 to 12, 2026. Registration dates are not posted on the page and 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H Day at the Statehouse
what_you_do: Students learn how state government works. They tour the Statehouse and meet state lawmakers. Some serve as student pages.
deadline_text: 2026 event was Feb 10. Registration closed Jan 19, 2026. The page does not say when the next event is.

grades: Youth who have completed grades 7 and 8
name: 4-H Round-Up at Purdue
what_you_do: A three-day stay in a Purdue residence hall for youth who just finished grades 7 and 8. Attend career classes made for Round-Up and get a taste of college life.
deadline_text: 2026 event ran June 10 to 12, 2026. Registration was open through May 22, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Teen 4-H leaders train to speak up for Indiana 4-H, act as role models for younger youth and work with adults and community partners. Training and workshops are held July 30 to August 1.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due April 15, 2026. Interviews were in the first two weeks of May and ambassadors were notified in the last week of May. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H State Fair Exhibit Hall Worker
what_you_do: Paid workers check in and display 4-H exhibits at the Indiana State Fair.
deadline_text: 2026 work dates were July 31 to Aug 25 (fair Aug 7 to 23). No application deadline was stated, and 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H
what_you_do: Teens join county clubs. Then they can join state programs such as State 4-H Ambassadors, Invention Convention, Shooting Sports Competition and 4-H Camp.
deadline_text: Join any time. State programs have their own dates.

name: Indiana DECA chapters and state conference
org: Indiana DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter at a school with business or marketing classes. Members build business skills. They compete at the Indiana state conference.
deadline_text: The Indiana DECA conference is February 26 to 28, 2027 at the Indianapolis Marriott Downtown. No membership deadline is posted.

name: Volunteer with Indiana DNR (youth volunteer agreement for under 18)
