deadline_text: Closed as of 2026-10-10. The page says most weekend and after-school youth shifts are full, and there is no waitlist.

name: Youth Volunteers for Conservation (YV4C)
what_you_do: Youth help restore prairie and savanna. For example, they gather native seeds. They learn to name basic native plants. They also hear about jobs in natural resources.
deadline_text: The only session listed was Saturday Oct 10, 2026, 1 to 3 pm at Pheasant Branch Conservancy, 5000 Pheasant Branch Rd, Middleton. No later dates are posted on the page; check MyImpact or ask for new sessions.

name: TEENworks at Goodman Community Center
what_you_do: These are paid teen jobs at the community center, with training. All teens earn ServSafe certification and get event catering training. They can also earn high school credit.
deadline_text: No dates or enrollment status are posted on the page.

name: High School Volunteers at Habitat for Humanity of Dane County
org: Habitat for Humanity of Dane County
what_you_do: Students volunteer at the Habitat ReStore or on home build sites. High school groups can also lead a fundraising project.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact Habitat to get started.

name: Zoo Teen Program
what_you_do: This is an eight-week summer program on conservation. You go behind the scenes at the zoo. You hear from local conservation groups. You work with animal care and environmental professionals.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 28 and closed Mar 1, 2026; notified Mar 2 to 13. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Henry Vilas Zoo Volunteer Program (teens 14 to 17)
what_you_do: Help at the zoo in roles such as gate greeter, goat yard attendant, events and wildlife champion. Training is given.
deadline_text: Applications for ongoing roles are posted each year between February and April.

name: MMoCA Teen Forum
what_you_do: Learn how an art exhibition is made. Create and run educational programs. Meet museum and arts professionals through job shadows.
deadline_text: The page says applications were closed for the 2025 Teen Forum. No 2026-27 dates are posted.

name: High School Science Research Internship Program
org: Madison Metropolitan School District with UW-Madison
what_you_do: Juniors work in a UW-Madison research lab 20 to 25 hours a week for 9 weeks. They go to campus talks and show a poster in September.
deadline_text: The summer 2026 deadline was Jan 16, 2026. December information meetings were held at each high school. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Youth Apprenticeship at Madison public schools
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors work part of their school day for a local employer in a field they pick, with a mentor. They earn school credit and state-recognized industry certificates.
deadline_text: Current cycle: explore October to December, priority application deadline February 13. The page prints no year for February 13, so no date is set. Interviews run March to July.

name: MSCR Youth Aquatics Assistant Swim Instructor
org: Madison School & Community Recreation (MSCR), Madison Metropolitan School District
what_you_do: A part-time job helping lead instructors teach Red Cross Learn-to-Swim classes at Madison school pools. You keep lessons fun and can learn to plan and co-teach classes.
deadline_text: Posted on the MSCR jobs page for the 2026-27 school year with no closing date. Apply while the posting is up.

name: Operation Fresh Start Legacy Program
what_you_do: You do paid, hands-on conservation or construction work. You get mentoring while you work toward a diploma. You earn an AmeriCorps Education Award when you finish.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. The page says Legacy is accepting applications.

name: Madison Public Library Volunteering (teens welcome)
what_you_do: Help a library branch with tasks. Tasks include pulling books for holds and packing maker kits. You can package seeds for the Seed Library. You can set up for programs.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings change by branch and season; several branches had no openings on the day the page was read.

name: Youth Volunteering at Second Harvest Foodbank
org: Second Harvest Foodbank of Southern Wisconsin
what_you_do: Youth volunteers sort and repack food in the warehouse during Food Sort/Repack shifts.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for a shift.

name: Assistant Naturalist, Earth Focus Day Camp
what_you_do: Volunteers help lead kids on hikes, nature games and science activities at a summer day camp in the Arboretum. Orientation and training are provided.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Ask for the assistant naturalist schedule.

name: Badger Dairy Camp
org: Department of Animal and Dairy Sciences, UW-Madison
what_you_do: A residential camp on the UW-Madison campus with hands-on workshops, tours and recreation about the dairy industry. Students also do college prep workshops and stay in a campus residence hall.
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: College Ready (online)
what_you_do: A 4 week live online course on how college admissions, financial aid and choosing a major work. Small groups, guest speakers and about 1 hour of homework a week.
deadline_text: The posted 2025 session had registration Sept 15 to Oct 16, 2025 and a scholarship deadline of Oct 14, 2025. The current session is not posted.

name: ARISE Summer Research Internship
org: University of Wisconsin Carbone Cancer Center
what_you_do: Interns work in a cancer research lab with a mentor, learn lab skills and do a project of their own. They also join career activities with nursing, pharmacy and pathology.
deadline_text: The 2026 window ran Dec 1, 2025 to Feb 6, 2026 at 5 pm. The page says to apply for the 2027 program next year.

name: HERO: Healthcare Experience and Research in Oncology
what_you_do: Over two weeks, students do fruit fly lab work at home. They join faculty talks and cancer career panels. They also show a patient case study with grad student mentors.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was April 24, 2026, with notices in mid May. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: UW Health Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You volunteer in a UW Health hospital or clinic. You do it for a full semester. You need a placement interview and onboarding first.
deadline_text: Application closed now. Spring semester applications are expected to open Dec 2, 2026, with onboarding finished by Jan 8, 2027. Summer expected to open Apr 12, 2027; fall expected in July 2027. All dates are subject to change.

name: PEOPLE Precollege
what_you_do: A program that supports students from 8th grade through high school graduation with advising, tutoring and college visits. Juniors in the summer do an internship with a campus or community partner.
deadline_text: The PEOPLE application opens at the end of January each year, and admissions are likely completed in May each year. The page gives no exact 2027 opening date.

name: Pharmacy Summer Program (PSP)
what_you_do: A 5 day camp where you stay on campus. Pharmacists and pharmacy students teach you about pharmacy jobs and how to get into pharmacy school (PharmD). You live in campus dorms.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was March 5 to 24, 2026 and closes early if spots fill. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Summer Arts Clinic
what_you_do: A week on campus choosing a path in dance, theater, visual art, or fashion design and textiles. Each course ends with a performance or exhibit.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened Jan 12 and closed May 15, 2026. Scholarship forms were due April 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Summer Music Clinic: Senior Session
what_you_do: A week on campus. You play in band, choir, orchestra and jazz groups. You take instrument and voice classes, composing and music tech. You also hear guest concerts.
deadline_text: 2026 registration ran Jan 12 to May 15, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Business Basics (Wisconsin School of Business)
what_you_do: A day camp at Grainger Hall that runs 4 days. Students do hands-on activities and an entrepreneurial challenge to build communication, problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
deadline_text: Applications are open December 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Space is limited, so apply early.

name: Entrepreneurship Boot Camp (Wisconsin School of Business)
what_you_do: A one-day workshop at Grainger Hall. Students learn what entrepreneurs do and take part in an entrepreneurship challenge led by the UW StartUp Learning Community staff.
deadline_text: Applications are open September 1 to October 30, 2026. The workshop is November 14, 2026.

name: Junior Business Badgers
what_you_do: A day camp at Grainger Hall that runs 4 days. Students explore business careers, visit local companies for job shadow trips, and get help with college essays and resumes.
deadline_text: Applications are open December 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Pick one session. A session may be canceled if enrollment is low.

name: Wanda Fullmore Youth Internship Program
org: Common Wealth Development with the City of Madison
what_you_do: An 8-week summer internship with mandatory training and weekly professional development. The library page says it is organized by Common Wealth Development for Madison youth to get involved with local government.
deadline_text: The library page does not post 2026 or 2027 dates. Check with Common Wealth Development.

name: WIOA Youth Program (WorkSmart Network)
org: Workforce Development Board of South Central Wisconsin
what_you_do: This is free career planning, skills training and work-based learning. A career planner builds a plan with you.
deadline_text: No deadline. The page says the online application is coming soon.

name: Wisconsin Youth Apprenticeship (Dane and Jefferson counties)
org: Workforce Development Board of South Central Wisconsin
what_you_do: Spend part of the week in class and part on a paid job with a business mentor. There are 16 program areas. It lasts 1 or 2 years.
deadline_text: No application deadline listed. Virtual information nights (7:00 to 7:45 pm): Nov 18, 2026; Dec 16, 2026; Jan 20, 2027; Mar 17, 2027; and Feb 17, 2027 (UW Health sessions).

name: American Legion Auxiliary Michigan Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Michigan
what_you_do: Spend a week running a mock state government and court system with students from across Michigan. You learn how state government works. You also practice leadership.
deadline_text: The 86th session is June 13 to 19, 2027 at Michigan State University. The 2027 application is posted online. No closing date is stated on the flyer or page.

name: American Legion Michigan Boys State
city: Hillsdale, MI (2026 session at Hillsdale College); office in Lansing
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model Michigan state government. Citizens are split into two parties, hold city, county and state elections, and learn how state government works. It is for rising seniors.
deadline_text: 2026 session: June 21 to 27, 2026 at Hillsdale College; application deadline was June 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the program pages.

name: Pre-Employment Transition Services for blind and low vision students (BSBP)
org: Bureau of Services for Blind Persons, Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
what_you_do: Students who are blind or have low vision get help planning the move from high school to college or work. BSBP runs programs for students in cities around Michigan throughout the year.
deadline_text: No deadline. Check the program calendar on the page for current programs.

name: Volunteer at Cranbrook Institute of Science
what_you_do: Share science with museum guests as a Nature Zone volunteer, Gallery Guide, or special events helper. Training is provided on the job.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A volunteer open house is offered.

name: Teen Volunteer at Dearborn Public Library
what_you_do: Teens help at the Dearborn Public Library. It takes teen applications now.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The program page says the library is only taking teen volunteer applications at this time.

name: Michigan DECA chapters and state conference
org: Michigan DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter and learn business skills in marketing, management, finance, hospitality or entrepreneurship. Chapters compete at the Michigan state conference.
deadline_text: The Michigan DECA conference is March 11 to 13, 2027 at Huntington Place in Detroit. No membership deadline is posted.

name: Detroit at Work Year-Round Youth Program
what_you_do: Get free help finishing school, training for a job, and finding paid work experience, internships, job shadowing, and pre-apprenticeships, with a career coach.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Call 313-962-9675 to ask.

name: Grow Detroit's Young Talent (GDYT)
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job or internship with a Detroit employer partner.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 13 to May 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: RYSE MED (Readying Youth Scientists for Excellence in Medicine)
what_you_do: For 6 weeks, shadow health care workers, do hands-on and virtual reality practice, and give a group talk on a health topic. Then join monthly meetings from September to May.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 group are closed. Details for the 2027-28 group come 'in the new year.'

name: Department of Surgery High School Mentorship Program
what_you_do: Learn about health careers through school visits and Saturday hands-on sessions (suturing, surgery practice, tours). Some students get a paid 7-week summer internship with a one-on-one mentor.
deadline_text: 2026 internship application closed April 30, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Medical Mentors Pathway Program (M2P2)
org: Wayne State University School of Medicine, Karmanos Cancer Institute and MI-AHEC
what_you_do: Shadow doctors and other health care workers in three 2-week hospital rotations, go to weekly classes, and earn a CPR and AED certificate.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. Applicants were told by April 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Volunteer at the Michigan Science Center
what_you_do: Help at the science center with projects and guest needs. Training is given for each role, and you can learn about shows and changing exhibits.
deadline_text: The page does not state a deadline or whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Use the online volunteer application.

grades: High school sophomores, juniors and seniors
name: Beginners' Investment Camp 101
org: University of Detroit Mercy, College of Business Administration (Charlton Center)
what_you_do: Learn basic investing from industry experts. Topics include saving versus investing, stocks, bonds and careers in finance. The camp has a trip to a financial center.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp has passed. Dates for 2027 are not posted.

name: Youth Health Exploration Camp
org: University of Detroit Mercy, College of Health Professions
what_you_do: Try health care skills hands on. You learn hands-only CPR, check vital signs and use a hospital simulator. You also tour campus and meet health workers.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp is full. Dates for 2027 are not posted.

name: Biomedical Career Advancement Program (BCAP)
org: Wayne State University School of Medicine and MI-AHEC Southeast Regional Center
what_you_do: Work with research mentors in a lab for 6 weeks, build your own research project, and present it at a symposium. Fridays have lab safety, CPR, and career panels.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications ran Feb 23 to Apr 24, 2026 (5 p.m.). Program ran July 6 to Aug 14, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Summer Academy high school camps
org: Wayne State University, Anderson College of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend a week on campus on real projects in coding, design, construction and game development. Special camps cover construction management, smart agriculture and aviation careers.
deadline_text: The page says all summer 2026 sessions are complete. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Zoo Corps (teen volunteers)
what_you_do: Talk with zoo visitors about conservation, lead science activities, and join workshops, field trips and behind-the-scenes visits.
deadline_text: Page says applications are now closed. No new dates posted. Past cycle closed in late spring.

name: Michigan FFA membership through a school ag class
what_you_do: Join a Michigan FFA chapter through a school agriculture class. FFA builds leadership and career skills. These are in agriculture, food and natural resources.
deadline_text: No membership deadline is posted.

name: FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) in Michigan
what_you_do: Join a team of high school students that builds a robot with mentors from industry. The team competes at district events and the state championship.
deadline_text: No 2027 dates are posted on the FRC page. It only shows 2026 events.

name: Forgotten Harvest Volunteer
what_you_do: Pack emergency food boxes and sort fresh food at the distribution center. The food goes to people in Wayne, Oakland and Macomb counties.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Volunteers sign up online ahead of time for a shift.

name: Summer Youth Program (volunteer)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital for one 4-hour shift a week for 8 weeks in the summer. You get a certificate and a letter that confirms your hours.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. No 2027 dates posted.

name: Summer Teen Volunteering at Henry Ford Providence Novi
what_you_do: Teens give 4 hours a week at the hospital. You work the same day, time and department each week.
deadline_text: Apply from March 1 to March 15, 2027 for summer 2027.

name: Summer Teen Volunteering at Henry Ford Providence Southfield
what_you_do: Teens volunteer for one 4-hour shift a week at the hospital. The day, time and department stay the same each week.
deadline_text: Apply from March 1 to March 15, 2027 for summer 2027.

name: Summer High School Volunteering at Henry Ford West Bloomfield
what_you_do: Teens help at the hospital in a weekly 4-hour shift. You keep the same day, time and department all summer.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was March 1 to March 15, 2026, and it is closed. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted on the program page.

grades: Middle school, high school and college students
name: Michigan HOSA (Future Health Professionals)
what_you_do: Join a school chapter, compete in health skills events at one of nine regional conferences, and the top finishers go on to the state conference in April and then the international conference.
deadline_text: 2027 state conference is in April at the Grand Traverse Resort. International conference: June 22 to 25, 2027, Philadelphia. Regional dates are on the 26-27 calendar page.

name: Metroparks Volunteer Workdays
city: Southeast Michigan (parks include Hudson Mills, Dexter-Huron, Stony Creek, Willow)
what_you_do: Spend a morning on hands-on clean-ups with the park natural resources team. Most of the work is removing invasive plants and helping native species. Tools, equipment and protective gear are provided.
deadline_text: Workdays run through the year. Sign up by noon the day before each one. The workdays listed on the page were July 11, Aug 22 and Sept 26 (the page does not show the year).

name: Jump-Start Jackson
what_you_do: Get paid on-the-job training with a local employer, a mentor, and lessons on soft skills like attendance, communication and managing money.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the program page.

grades: Junior or senior in high school, or age 24 or younger
name: YouthWorks (Livingston County summer jobs)
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job at a local worksite in a field you pick, with one day a week of classroom training on workplace and career skills.
deadline_text: 2026 program ran June 15 to Aug 14, 2026. Application dates for 2027 not posted.

name: Pre-Employment Transition Services for students with disabilities (Michigan Rehabilitation Services)
org: Michigan Rehabilitation Services, Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
what_you_do: Get help with job exploration, work-based learning, planning for college or training, workplace readiness, and speaking up for yourself. Staff work with your school and IEP team.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply any time.

name: Michigan Tech Summer Youth Programs
org: Michigan Technological University, Summer Youth Programs
what_you_do: Take a week-long exploration course at Michigan Tech. Topics run from STEM and engineering to business, the arts and the humanities. You can live on campus or commute.
grades: Middle and high school (exact grades not stated)
deadline_text: 2027 registration and program dates are not posted yet on the program pages. Balances are due in full by May 1 and most scholarships are reviewed on a rolling basis.

name: Oakland NEXT paid internships and career exploration
city: Oakland County, MI (Pontiac and other service centers)
what_you_do: Explore careers, join training, and take part in paid internships with local employers. Each work experience includes learning about career paths and job skills.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the Oakland NEXT application and staff will contact you.

name: Oakland County Parks Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in the Oakland County parks. You pick the park site and the kinds of work you like when you apply.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The county takes applications only for current openings posted on Idealist.

name: Wolverine Pathways
city: Detroit, Southfield, Ypsilanti and Grand Rapids, MI
what_you_do: A free college prep program. Students meet on Saturdays and for 2 to 4 weeks each summer for classes, camps and internships. Scholars admitted to U-M Ann Arbor or U-M Dearborn get a 4-year tuition scholarship.
grades: Apply in 6th or 9th grade; join in 7th or 10th grade
deadline_text: The next application window opens in December 2026. Last cycle, Southeast Michigan applications closed February 28, 2026 and Grand Rapids applications closed March 20, 2026.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Michigan Wing
what_you_do: Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets lead small teams and study aerospace. They sometimes fly in CAP aircraft. They go to a week-long summer encampment.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

name: WIOA Youth Program through your local Michigan Works! agency
org: Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity, delivered by local Michigan Works! agencies (Michigan Works! Southeast for Washtenaw County, Capital Area Michigan Works! for the Lansing area)
what_you_do: This is free job-readiness help for young people who face barriers. It includes tutoring and mentoring. You can get paid and unpaid work experience. That includes summer jobs. You get skills training and help planning for college or a career.
deadline_text: Operated year round by local Michigan Works! agencies. No state deadline is posted.

name: YMCA Michigan Youth in Government
what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. You take part in a student-run model government. There are fall district conferences. There is a big Lansing conference in February or April.
deadline_text: Fall district conferences run Oct 2 to Nov 9, 2026. Sign-up closes about two weeks before each one. District 6 (Detroit, Nov 9) closes Oct 26, 2026. Sign-up for the other fall districts has ended. Lansing sign-up opens Nov 10, 2026. February Lansing conference (Feb 18 to 21, 2027): regular sign-up closes Dec 27, 2026, late sign-up Dec 28 to Jan 13 with a $25 fee. April Lansing conference (Apr 22 to 25, 2027): regular sign-up closes Feb 28, 2027, late sign-up Mar 1 to 17 with a $25 fee.

name: Michigan Youth Challenge Academy (MYCA)
org: Michigan National Guard, Michigan Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
what_you_do: A free program with a 5 and a half month stay on site and 12 months of follow up. You work on your diploma, leadership, job skills, fitness, life skills and community service.
deadline_text: Two cycles a year. The January start application opens Aug 1. The July start application opens Feb 1. The application takes place over the 4 to 5 months before each cycle. No closing date is posted.

name: Step Up (Foundations level)
org: City of Minneapolis, Community Planning and Economic Development
what_you_do: You get a paid summer internship. Employers include parks, community groups, public agencies and nonprofits. The internship builds your first work experience. You get mentoring. You must finish a required orientation first.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was Jan 5 to Mar 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted; the city says applications open each January and offers a sign-up for 2027 updates.

name: Minnesota 4-H
org: University of Minnesota Extension, Minnesota 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club or county program. You learn by doing and grow as a young person outside of school.
grades: Kindergarten through one year past high school (grade 13)
deadline_text: No fixed deadline on the Join page. Membership lasts Oct. 1 to Sept. 30 and you re-enroll each year.

name: Minnesota American Legion Boys State
what_you_do: Spend a week at Saint John's University running a pretend government. You elect city, county and state officials. You go to classes and mock trials. You hear political speakers.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted. Each sponsor sets its own. Ask your school counselor or a local American Legion Post.

name: Minnesota DECA (high school)
org: Minnesota DECA, chartered association of DECA Inc.
what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter to learn business and marketing. You take part in DECA programs and contests, such as role plays. Minnesota DECA holds a yearly state conference.
deadline_text: Membership deadlines are set by the state advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 28 to Mar 2, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Minneapolis.

name: Minnesota FFA
what_you_do: Join an agriculture class and your school's FFA chapter. You build leadership and career skills. Members can go to leadership conferences, a winter leadership summit and the State FFA Convention.
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.

name: Minnesota House High School Page Program
org: Minnesota House of Representatives, Sergeant at Arms Office
what_you_do: Spend one week at the State Capitol. You page on the House floor, sit in a mock committee meeting, and meet legislators, judges, lobbyists and reporters.
deadline_text: Complete applications are due by end of business on Nov 10, 2026 for the 2027 session. Selected students are told by email by mid-December.

name: Minnesota State Fair Employment
what_you_do: Teens work the 12-day State Fair for fair departments or vendors. Summer jobs and fall clean-up jobs are also posted.
deadline_text: The Employment Center runs June to August for fair applicants. The page says to check back in June 2027 for registration updates.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, Minnesota Wing
city: Statewide, MN (squadrons in Duluth, St. Paul, Alexandria and more)
what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aviation, fitness and character. You wear an Air Force style uniform and earn promotions. You plan activities. You have no duty to join the military.
deadline_text: Join any time. Visit a squadron meeting first.

name: Minnesota Youth Council
what_you_do: Be one of the young people who advise the Governor and state lawmakers on issues that affect youth. You research issues, meet your legislators and hold a town hall in your district.
deadline_text: The 2026 round (for the 2026 to 2028 term) took applications from January to March 2026: Feb 28 for priority consideration, Mar 31 for all applications. No 2027 dates are posted. Seats also open when members graduate or step down.

name: Minnesota Youth Institute (MNYI)
org: University of Minnesota College of Food, Agricultural and Natural Resource Sciences
what_you_do: Students write a research paper on a global food security problem and present their ideas at a one day event on the St. Paul campus. Top presenters may go to the Global Youth Institute in Iowa.
deadline_text: 2026: register by March 27, paper due April 3, event May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: ZooTeen volunteers
what_you_do: Help run Zoo Camps: keep track of campers, help with crafts and activities, and be a role model for younger kids.
deadline_text: Applications for the Summer 2026 ZooTeen camp season are closed. The page says to check the website in 2027 for next summer.

grades: New applicants enter 7th, 8th or 9th grade this fall (Tree Monitor spots for new people are for high school age)
name: Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help in the Children's Garden as a Naturalist or Gardener. Or track how trees change through the seasons as a Tree Monitor. Returning volunteers can help at the summer science camp.
deadline_text: The page says applications are reviewed in April each year. An exact deadline is not posted. Email youthvolunteers@mortonarb.org to get deadline notices.

name: Naperville Community Job Fair
what_you_do: Meet hiring managers face to face. Past fairs also offered resume reviews, mock interviews and money basics. There was also a high school panel on career paths in Illinois.
deadline_text: Saturday, January 2, 2027, 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., Fort Hill Activity Center, 20 Fort Hill Drive, Naperville.

name: Teen Pitch Program
what_you_do: A team of 2 to 5 teens pitches an idea for a library event. If your team is picked, the library pays for supplies and helps you plan and run the event in summer 2027.
deadline_text: The 2026 application ran August 1 to September 30, 2026 and is closed. The page does not give 2027 dates. Teams picked for the in-person pitch are contacted by mid October 2026.

grades: Volunteers: 9th grade and up. TAG: grades 6 to 12
name: Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Group (TAG)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library. Or join TAG, a monthly group. Teens work with teen librarians on events, books, games and teen spaces.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.

name: Mayor's Chief of Staff Internship (KidsMatter)
what_you_do: Support the mayor at community events. You greet people, answer questions and take photos. Hours follow the event schedule, with some evenings and weekends.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due 5 p.m. Friday, Sept. 4, 2026. Selected students start at the KidsMatter Leadership Academy on Saturday, Nov. 7 (this fall). The city post is dated August 10, 2026. Next year's call is not posted yet.

name: Seasonal and Part-Time Jobs (Centennial Beach, camps, parks)
what_you_do: Apply for seasonal and part-time park district jobs. Jobs include lifeguard, swim teacher, camp counselor and paddleboat attendant. You can also work at concessions, park upkeep or a golf course.
deadline_text: The page's table says Centennial Beach jobs (lifeguard, concession, swim instructor), paddleboat jobs, camp counselors and Knoch Knolls nature camp jobs are usually posted in mid December. Other jobs post in May, June or August. The Community Job Fair is held the first Saturday in January.

name: Volunteer Programs and Events (ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Help run park district events. Examples are Kids' Night Out (climbing, crafts and games) and Santa's Workshop (greeting families, photos, goody bags). There are also Nature Champion volunteer days. You can get proof of your hours for school.
deadline_text: Apply at least two weeks before the date you want to volunteer. Santa's Workshop runs December 1 to 20, 2026 and Kids' Night Out runs Fridays, November 20 to December 18, 2026. The weekdays on the page match 2026.

name: Police Cadet Program
what_you_do: Meet at the police department twice a month for training. You help with security and traffic at community events during the year.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the page.

grades: In high school or entering high school
name: Youth Academy
what_you_do: Take a free six week course on police work. It covers patrol, K-9 dogs, investigations, the special response team and forensics, with hands-on demos.
deadline_text: 2026 class: June 11 to July 23, 2026, applications due June 4, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Student Representatives on City Boards and Commissions
what_you_do: Sit on a city board or commission as a student rep. You might join the Library Board, Planning and Zoning, the Riverwalk board or the Transportation Advisory Board. You start with a leadership orientation.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due 5 p.m. Friday, Sept. 4, 2026. Selected students start at the KidsMatter Leadership Academy on Saturday, Nov. 7 (this fall). The city post is dated August 10, 2026. Next year's call is not posted yet.

name: High School Career Academy
what_you_do: This is a paid six-month after-school program. You learn about several health care careers. You go to two evening sessions a month, from November to April.
deadline_text: Registration for 2026-2027 is closed. 2027-28 dates are not posted.

name: Youth and Young Adult Employment Program (paid summer work experience)
what_you_do: You get a paid summer placement. It is a work-learning job in a hospital department. It is about 4 hours a day. It includes career exploration. You also get mentorship and financial literacy.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened Feb 2 and closed March 27, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: NISRA Volunteers and Summer Camp Jobs (Elgin and 12 other member communities)
city: Elgin and 12 other member communities, northern Illinois
what_you_do: Volunteer to give one-on-one help in recreation programs for people with disabilities. Or apply for part-time jobs like program helper and summer day camp counselor. Programs meet once a week for 1 to 3 hours.
deadline_text: No deadline. NISRA says it hires summer camp staff each winter and spring. Postings are on the ADP Workforce Now site.

name: Civic Leadership Institute (CTD Summer Camp)
org: Northwestern University Center for Talent Development
what_you_do: Take a 3 week course on current social and political issues. You learn through service, talks with community leaders and study. You do service projects and make a plan for change.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 28 to July 17, 2026. 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet. The program has said to apply early for aid.

name: Summer Volunteer Service for Students
org: Northwestern Medicine (Delnor in Geneva, Central DuPage in Winfield, Lake Forest and other suburban hospitals)
city: Geneva, Winfield, Lake Forest and other suburbs, IL
what_you_do: Volunteer one day a week for eight weeks in a hospital in the summer.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer application period is closed. The page says to check back for the 2027 Summer Service Period in early autumn. It gives no 2027 dates on this page.

grades: Current high school juniors (rising seniors), no exceptions
name: Medill Cherubs Journalism Institute
org: Northwestern University, Medill School of Journalism
what_you_do: Spend 4 weeks on the Northwestern campus learning to report, write and produce news. Work with journalism faculty and professionals.
deadline_text: No applications before December 1, 2026. All materials are due by noon Central on March 1, 2027. Decisions by March 24, 2027.

name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Policy Debate Institute
what_you_do: Train in policy style debate in a 4 week or 6 week summer institute. The 2026 institute was fully online.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application opens this winter. Rolling admission through April or until the labs are full. 2026 dates were June 28 to July 25 (4 weeks) and June 28 to August 8 (6 weeks).

name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Film and Video Division
what_you_do: Spend 5 weeks on the Northwestern campus making films. Take courses such as acting for the screen, sound and on-set work, and finish with a festival of student films.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 9, 2026 and regular deadline March 13, 2026, with rolling late applications for some concentrations. 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.

name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Theatre Arts Division
what_you_do: Live on the Northwestern campus for 5 weeks. Take acting, voice and movement classes, work on a crew, and rehearse a full play with professional directors. Tracks: Performance, Stage Management and Design/Tech, Musical Theatre.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 2, 2026 and regular deadline February 27, 2026 (online form). 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.

name: Leading Edge Teen Advisory Board (LETAB)
what_you_do: A teen-led group that helps create library programs. It promotes library services and serves the community. It gives teens a voice and ways to lead.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. The page has an Apply now button.

name: Acorns to Oaks Volunteer Team (teens 14 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteer at park district events like Winter Fest, Fall Fest, concerts and the Frank Lloyd Wright Races, or help at the ice show and other programs. Earn rewards for your hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Summer and Seasonal Park District Jobs
what_you_do: Work a summer job at parks, recreation centers, pools, camps and youth programs. The district says it is the largest youth employer in the area. It hires about 300 summer workers a year.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the jobs page. Applications are kept for one year, then you must reapply.

name: Ohio 4-H clubs and projects
org: Ohio 4-H Youth Development, Ohio State University Extension
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club in your county and choose a project from more than 200 options. Teens can keep going in 4-H through the year they turn 19.
deadline_text: Each county sets an enrollment deadline. The state page does not list a date.

name: Buckeye Boys State
what_you_do: Spend eight days at Miami University running a mock state government. Delegates join caucuses and hold elections. They meet Ohio officials. They go to a college fair. It has 50+ colleges and service academies.
grades: Interview in junior year, attend before senior year
deadline_text: Session dates and deadlines are not posted on the program pages. Legion post interviews are usually held in winter or spring at high schools.

name: Ohio DECA chapters and state conference
org: Ohio DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter in a school career-technical program. You build business skills. Chapters compete at the Ohio state conference in Columbus.
deadline_text: The Ohio DECA conference is February 22 to 24, 2027 at the Greater Columbus Convention Center. No membership deadline is posted.

grades: Entering freshman year of high school through freshman year of college
name: ExploreAg (Ohio Farm Bureau career camps)
city: Ohio (one-day camps in Columbus, Wilmington, Findlay and more)
what_you_do: Hands-on one-day camps and a weeklong camp in summer. They show you jobs in food science, crops, farm tech, food making, animal care and more. Fall 2026 includes a Columbus day on Oct. 21.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 one-day camps, per the flyer and ofbf.org: Wilmington Oct. 13, Columbus Oct. 21, COLT Lineman Training (Mount Gilead) Oct. 23, Meat Processing (Yorkshire) Oct. 27, Findlay Nov. 3. Registration closes 10 days before each event or when full. By that rule Wilmington (about Oct. 3) and Columbus (about Oct. 11) have already closed. Still open by that rule: COLT (about Oct. 13), Meat Processing (about Oct. 17) and Findlay (about Oct. 24, 2026). The page does not post close dates itself.

name: Ohio FFA membership through your school chapter
org: Ohio FFA Association (Ohio Department of Education and Workforce)
what_you_do: Join FFA at a school that has an Ohio FFA chapter. Members build leadership and career skills in agriculture and take part in Career Development Events.
deadline_text: Next date: Nov 30, 2026, for all chapters. The September 30, 2026 date for students in Fall CDEs has passed. Membership opens each August through FFA.org.

grades: Rising 9th to 12th graders (for the two high school camps)
name: STEM Summer Camps (Ohio State Marion)
org: The Ohio State University at Marion
what_you_do: Week-long day camps with lab work: DNA and water testing, robot building and programming, field trips and a cardboard boat race. Two camps are for high schoolers (Science Adventurers and Horizons of Science).
deadline_text: 2026 camps ran June 22 to 26, 2026 and registration closed May 31, 2026 or earlier if full. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Ohio State Fair Junior Fair Board
org: Ohio Expo Center, Ohio State Fair
what_you_do: Serve as a welcoming host for about two weeks at the Ohio State Fair: welcome guests at fair events, and meet people for networking. Housing and meals are provided.
deadline_text: The page says the online application portal opens January 1 and the application is due March 1 ((year inferred from the next cycle)). Notices come early to mid March, interviews mid to late March, selection early April. Confirm the 2027 dates in January.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at The Wilds
what_you_do: Teens choose one or both of two paths. Restoration Ecology has more field work. Conservation Education means talking with visitors. It is at a wildlife conservation center.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates are posted on the volunteer page. The visitor season runs May through October for adult volunteers.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Ohio Wing
what_you_do: Join a year-round cadet squadron. You learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets wear uniforms and learn drill. They earn promotions and plan their own activities.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

name: Ohio Youth & Government (YMCA model government)
org: Ohio Alliance of YMCAs, Ohio Youth & Government
city: Columbus, OH (State Assembly), delegations across Ohio
what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. Prepare in the fall. Then take part in a student-run model government at the spring State Assembly in Columbus. High school roles include legislator, court, lobbyist and media.
deadline_text: Last cycle: State Assembly February 12 to 14, 2026 at the Hyatt Regency Columbus. Registration closed November 28, 2025, with late registration December 1 to 10, 2025. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

grades: Service projects: grades 6 to 12. Member Services: grades 9 to 12 (20 hour minimum). Book reviewers: grades 6 to 8. Teen Advisory Board: grades 9 to 12.
name: Teen Service Projects, Volunteers and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Do 2 hour summer service projects, help in Member Services or review books for credit. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It meets monthly in the school year.
deadline_text: Book review hours count for reviews submitted September 1, 2026 to May 15, 2027. Teen Advisory Board applications run August 1 to 31, and that window has passed.

grades: Junior high and senior high students are encouraged
name: Pleasant Home Volunteer Docents (students welcome)
org: Park District of Oak Park (Pleasant Home)
what_you_do: Be a volunteer docent at Pleasant Home, a National Historic Landmark. You share its history and building style with visitors. You help make their visit one to remember.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: CampMed (free summer health camp)
what_you_do: Spend 5 days on campus. You practice hands-on health care skills like CPR, stitching and head-to-toe exams. You also explore careers with RFU graduate students in medicine, pharmacy, nursing and physical therapy.
deadline_text: The page gives no application dates. The camp runs during the last week of July.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science

grades: High school and college students from Lake County
name: INSPIRE: Summer research and mentoring for Lake County students
what_you_do: Spend 8 weeks doing original biomedical research. A graduate student mentor and a faculty advisor guide you. Daily sessions and weekly workshops cover health care careers, writing, math and science. You can return each summer through college.
deadline_text: The INSPIRE 2026 application is closed. The page says the INSPIRE 2027 application will open in December 2026.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science

name: Nursing INSPIRE (paid summer program)
what_you_do: Take part in an 8 week summer program, four days a week. It explores nursing careers and college prep. It includes nursing assistant training. Then you can take the Certified Nursing Assistant exam.
deadline_text: The page still shows the last cycle it read: applications opened December 10, 2024 and closed January 23, 2025. Newer dates are not posted.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science

name: Science Saturdays
what_you_do: Learn core lab techniques and the scientific method in 9 Saturday sessions on campus. Lunch and transportation are provided. Up to 25 students join each summer.
deadline_text: The Science Saturdays 2026 application is closed. For 2027 the application will open in December 2026.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science

grades: Local high school and undergraduate students
name: Virtual Mentor Program
what_you_do: Get matched with a current Rosalind Franklin University student. They mentor you about health care or science careers. After an orientation, you meet once a month by video call or phone from October to May.
deadline_text: Registration closes November 30, 2026.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science

name: Tween and Teen Volunteers and Book Buddies (summer)
what_you_do: Help around the library with craft prep and light cleaning. Or be a Book Buddy. You are paired with a young reader entering grades 1 to 3.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 deadline was Friday, May 1 and the page says Summer 2026 applications are now closed. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Rush Copley Medical Center
what_you_do: Help in areas like the gift shop, greeting and escort services, office support and patient care areas. Teens support staff and patients with comfort and friendly help. They do not do medical tasks.
deadline_text: The page said it was accepting applications for the 2026 summer program. Applications are kept on file for 3 months. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Student Summer Volunteer Program at Rush Oak Park Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer in hospital areas such as information desks and the emergency department. You can also help in the lab, nursing, same day surgery and physical therapy. Parking is free.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: Library volunteer (teens 14 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a neighborhood library. You can be a reading mentor. You can be a homework tutor. You can be a tech assistant. Other roles are teen mentor, garden helper and library assistant.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Right Track youth jobs (YJ1 and YJ2 summer internships)
org: City of Saint Paul Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Paid summer jobs and internships. YJ1 places teens in rec centers, pools, libraries, gardening and nonprofits. YJ2 is for ages 16 and up in business, health, trades and other career fields.
deadline_text: Youth apply online February 1-28 for summer. The page does not print the year, so confirm the dates for 2027.

name: Student Advisory Trustee, Schaumburg Township District Library
what_you_do: This is a non-voting seat on the Library Board. You give feedback on teen programs. You speak for teens at Schaumburg, Conant and Hoffman Estates High Schools. You attend monthly Board meetings. You help with at least two library events.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application period ended August 9, 2026. The page gives no 2027 application dates.

name: Volunteer Squad (summer teen volunteers)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library over the summer. High school students can earn service hours. The library also keeps a list of volunteer options in the community.
deadline_text: The page says opportunities are posted in the spring and take place over the summer. No dates are given for 2027.

name: Aquatics and Seasonal Park Jobs
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at district pools and The Water Works as a lifeguard, swim instructor or concession worker. Paid lifeguard CPR and AED training is provided. Other seasonal park and recreation jobs are on the district job board.
deadline_text: The newest date on the page is old. The latest job fair post is dated February 18, 2025, and lists fairs on March 19, April 16 and May 8, 2025 at the Community Recreation Center, 505 N. Springinsguth Road. No newer fair dates are posted. Ask the district or check its job board for current openings.

name: Teen Volunteer Service and Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Join teen service events during the school year and school breaks. The Teen Library Council meets regularly on Thursday afternoons.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library during the school year or in a summer session. The application also asks whether you can work on your own and if you have a driver's license.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates are posted on the application page.

name: VolunTEENs and Service Hour Projects (ages 13 to 18)
city: Sugar Grove, IL (Kane County, near Aurora)
what_you_do: Shelve books, help with grounds care, help at the summer reading check-in table, or do a short service hour project. The library has a VolunTEENs program just for ages 13 to 18.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Summer reading volunteering is seasonal.

grades: High school students and recent graduates
name: The Trade Collective (skilled trades student sign-up)
what_you_do: This Evanston group links students to local firms and to job training. You learn skilled trades. Trades include plumbing, HVAC and automotive. Others are electrical, aviation and manufacturing. Students meet business owners. The owners can help start careers.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Summer Speech and Debate Camps (high school)
what_you_do: Debate and speech camps at Augsburg. They cover policy, Lincoln-Douglas, Congress, Public Forum and speech. There is also a workshop on speaking up for a community issue.
deadline_text: 2026 early bird ended March 29; scholarship priority deadline March 1 and last call May 10, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Minnesota Business Venture (MBV)
what_you_do: Teams build a made-up product and business plan, then pitch it Shark Tank style at the end of the week. Includes speakers, mock interviews and breakouts.
deadline_text: MBV 2027 dates are not posted yet. The site says to check back.

name: Children's Minnesota 16 and 17 year old summer volunteers
what_you_do: Summer volunteering at a children's hospital. Teens help with the activities cart, the Child Life Zone, the sibling play area and Star Studio.
deadline_text: The teen page gives no application dates. Complete applications go on a summer waiting list.

name: Production Job Shadowing
what_you_do: Shadow a team that helps put on a show, such as stage management, lights or sound. You learn how a show is made.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.

name: Nature Walk Summer Teen Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help visitors connect with Como's animals and plants and learn to care about nature. The program also builds work experience and job skills.
deadline_text: The page says applications are no longer being accepted for this summer. Next dates are not posted.

name: Conservation Corps Youth Education: Youth Interns
what_you_do: Learn about nature and caring for natural areas. Build outdoor skills. Finish community projects with a crew led by young adults. You are based at a nature center or park in the Twin Cities area.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted for summer 2027. The page lists 2026 home bases only.

name: Cookie Cart Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Teens start with a 90 day work readiness internship, then can interview for the paid Bakery Program, where you earn while you learn. Cart Captains get a raise.
deadline_text: The page says applications are always accepted. Session dates are not posted.

name: Design Camp
what_you_do: A four day summer design camp at Dunwoody for high school students. It includes lunch, supplies and a field trip.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed July 13, 2026. The page says summer 2027 details are expected in January or February 2027.

name: Pathways to Careers (youth chapter)
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors join monthly workshops and a 3 week summer experience. It has job site visits, hands-on projects and mentoring. Students who enroll at Dunwoody can get a scholarship.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed (the deadline was April 19). The page says Fall 2027 applications open in early fall; no date posted yet. Online info sessions Nov 5, Dec 3, 2026 and Jan 7, Feb 4, Mar 4, Apr 8, 2027 (RSVP required).

name: Genesys Works Twin Cities (training and paid internship)
what_you_do: Students finish 8 weeks of summer training in IT, business and work skills. Then they work a paid, year-long internship at a partner company. They get college and career coaching.
grades: Junior year per the FAQ (apply in fall or winter of junior year). The application page says rising senior. Ask which grade.
deadline_text: No date is posted. Students apply in fall or winter of junior year and the process finishes in the spring.

name: Student Summer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers work one weekday shift a week at the children's hospital in downtown Saint Paul. They work on their own. They are at ease around patients with disabilities and complex medical needs.
deadline_text: The page says applications for summer 2026 are closed. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.

name: Girls Inc. Eureka! STEM program (YWCA Minneapolis)
org: Girls Inc. at YWCA Minneapolis, with University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering
what_you_do: Join a five year STEM program. It has summer camp at the University of Minnesota and YWCA Midtown, plus school year support. You explore STEM careers and meet mentors. In high school you can do a stipend internship.
grades: Grades 8 to 12 (the University of Minnesota page says students entering grades 8 and 9 can apply)
deadline_text: The 2026 summer dates were June 29 to July 24, 2026 (no camp July 4). The page says registration is currently closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Microscope Adventure Summer Camp
what_you_do: A weeklong day camp. You use light microscopes and Hamline's scanning electron microscope. Then you make microscope images in teams and show them.
deadline_text: Registration opens Monday, Oct 26, 2026. Scholarship application due March 30, 2027 (supporting documents due April 15, 2027).

name: HealthPartners volunteer program for high school students
what_you_do: High school volunteers work weekly shifts of two to four hours in HealthPartners hospitals and clinics. You get training in your department first.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The process takes about 3 to 4 weeks.

name: Hennepin Healthcare hospital volunteers (ages 16 and up)
what_you_do: Help out at a big trauma hospital in downtown Minneapolis. Most new helpers start at the front, showing patients and guests where to go. Later you can move to other parts of the hospital.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time and finish the steps within 6 weeks.

name: Youth and Young Adult Services
city: Minneapolis, Saint Paul and Bloomington, MN
what_you_do: One on one career coaching, job and resume help, and help applying for partner employers' internships and jobs. Hired does not run internships itself. Also help with a diploma or GED, skills training and life skills.
deadline_text: The page does not state an application deadline. Staff aim to follow up quickly after you send the referral form.

name: JXTALabs Paid Apprenticeships
what_you_do: Young artists work on paid projects for clients in studios. The studios are for graphic design, modern art or environmental design. Working artists, designers and architects train you.
deadline_text: No deadlines are posted.

name: Visual Art Literacy Training (VALT)
what_you_do: A 10 week drawing and design course taught by working artists. Finishing one session lets you interview for paid JXTALabs apprenticeships, which start at age 14.
deadline_text: Sessions: fall Sept 16 to Nov 20, 2026 (Tue and Thu, 4:00 to 6:30 pm) and winter Jan 6 to Mar 12, 2027. Summer 2026 ran June 23 to Aug 27. The page does not post an application deadline or registration dates.

name: High school volunteer program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers serve at M Health Fairview hospitals after an interview, online learning and orientation. Service is about 100 hours. That is roughly 3 to 4 hours a week for 6 to 9 months.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.

name: Minneapolis Parks Teen Teamworks
what_you_do: Do work experiences with the Park Board. They teach work skills, decision making, communication and a good work ethic. Photo captions on the page show crews doing garden, painting and sign install projects.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 season are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Minneapolis Park Board Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Serve on a youth council. It gives feedback on Park Board programs and processes. Members plan community events and build leadership and research skills. They explore careers. They help guide anti-violence outreach.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the council page.

name: Minnesota ACE Camp (Aviation Career Education)
what_you_do: A one week aviation career camp for high school students in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul area. Each of two sessions is limited to 30 students.
deadline_text: The page says the window is open each year from Feb 1 to April 1. 2027 is not posted yet. Aid decisions come in April.

name: Expand Your Mind (EYM)
what_you_do: Two week summer sessions at Macalester College. Each student takes one class per session from nearly 30 offerings (max 16 students per class) and joins daily rec time. You can live in a dorm.
grades: Entering 9 to 12 (page also says current 8th to 11th)
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 1, 2027 and are reviewed as they arrive. Aid offers start May 1.

name: Open Arms youth volunteering
what_you_do: Teens help in the kitchen, on the farms, or on meal deliveries. You work with Open Arms staff after an orientation.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for an orientation.

name: Teen volunteer application
what_you_do: Teens help with library materials, teen services, children's services or other tasks. Branches include Maplewood, Mounds View, New Brighton, North St. Paul, Roseville, Shoreview and White Bear Lake. Some tasks involve lifting and pushing carts.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

name: Ecosystems of STEM Careers High School Internship
org: The Raptor Center, University of Minnesota
what_you_do: Ten interns spend four weeks exploring STEM careers. There are four field trips, and lunch once a week on trip days.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was April 3, 2026, with interviews in mid April. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Regions Hospital summer volunteer program
what_you_do: A 10 to 12 week summer volunteer program at Regions Hospital and HealthPartners clinics. Most shifts are 2 to 4 hours once a week, and no health care experience is needed.
deadline_text: The page says to apply for the summer program between January 1 and April 30, with no year shown. Late applications are not considered.

name: Lifeguard Training
org: City of Saint Paul Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: A Red Cross lifeguard course (lifeguarding with deep water, CPR/AED and first aid, valid 2 years). Graduates can be hired as City of Saint Paul lifeguards.
deadline_text: No course dates are posted. Main summer hiring for certified guards runs mid April to June.

name: Youth on Boards (Summer Academy and board seat)
org: City of Saint Paul (Parks and Recreation, Right Track and Sprockets)
what_you_do: A paid 8 week Summer Academy gets you ready to join a city board. The term is two years. Boards include Parks and Recreation, Transportation and Neighborhood Safety.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The page does not give a year for its dates, so treat them as a yearly pattern.

name: Kitty Andersen Youth Science Center (high school program)
what_you_do: High schoolers work as paid museum employees in a program built to feel like a real workplace. They pick from four STEM areas and get advising, portfolio help, college visits and career fairs.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the page.

name: Pathways Summer Internship
what_you_do: A short paid summer internship on Spark-Y projects around the Twin Cities. Team Lead roles guide interns aged 14 to 18.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Join the waitlist to be told first when it opens.

name: Counselor-in-Training
org: Three Rivers Park District (Baker Outdoor Learning Center)
what_you_do: Teens get training and spend at least one week of summer camp helping staff at Baker Outdoor Learning Center.
deadline_text: Applications are usually accepted March through May. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Naturalist Youth Leader Program
org: Three Rivers Park District (Eastman Nature Center)
what_you_do: Teens help the guides at Eastman Nature Center run its summer camps for kids.
deadline_text: Applications usually open in January, with interviews in February. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Pathways Internships
what_you_do: Paid summer interns pick one area of parks and recreation to try. Areas include outdoor lessons, camps, events, farm and garden work, and IT and GIS. Interns build job skills at Development Days.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 program are closed. Next dates are not posted.

name: Silverwood Teen Arts Council
what_you_do: Teens on the council do 30 hours of service at Silverwood Park. That includes working with pro artists.
deadline_text: Applications are usually accepted April to June, and may be accepted later in the year.

name: ThreeSixty Journalism summer programs
org: ThreeSixty Journalism, University of St. Thomas
what_you_do: Summer workshops in radio, multimedia stories and college essay writing. ThreeSixty staff, alumni and St. Thomas faculty lead them. Finish one and you can win a full four year scholarship to study Emerging Media at St. Thomas.
deadline_text: 2026 priority deadline was April 17 (radio camp April 30), with rolling admission to May 31. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Biomedical Engineering High School Internship Program
org: University of Minnesota Department of Biomedical Engineering
what_you_do: Rising seniors spend six weeks touring labs like the Visible Heart Lab. They do hands-on research with a grad student. They share their work at a poster session.
deadline_text: The page says it is not accepting applications for Summer 2026. Check back for Summer 2027.

name: Discover STEM (University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering)
org: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering Student Services
what_you_do: Spend one week on the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. You learn about current research and careers. You see talks and lab tours. You see science experiments and technology demos. You join Q&A sessions.
deadline_text: Summer 2026: sessions were Aug 3 to 7 and Aug 10 to 14, 2026. Applications were open April 20 to May 18, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Go4Brains High-School Summer Neuroscience Program
org: University of Minnesota, Department of Neuroscience
what_you_do: A one week program. Students hold a human brain and get an EEG brain print. They tour research labs, run their own experiments and work with mentors. They also show a poster.
deadline_text: The deadline to apply was March 1, 2026, and it has passed. A notice on the page still lists applications for Summer 2026 as open, but the deadline shown is past. The page posts no 2027 dates. Watch for the next round.

name: LHI-AHA Summer Research Scholars Program (high school)
org: University of Minnesota Medical School, Lillehei Heart Institute
what_you_do: High school scholars work full time for 8 weeks in a heart research lab at the University of Minnesota. They also go to a research event. It is called Cardiopalooza.
deadline_text: Applications open Dec 1, 2026 and close Feb 15, 2027.

name: IMA-MathCEP Math Modeling Camp
org: University of Minnesota MathCEP and the Institute for Mathematics and its Applications
what_you_do: Students use math to model real problems. These include bridge traffic, disease trends, food deserts and light rail routes. The camp is at the Minneapolis campus.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 31, 2026. Registration may pause if the camp fills. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Rooted in STEM
org: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering
what_you_do: A Saturday program (4 Saturdays each fall and spring, 10 am to 1 pm) with lab tours, demos, mentors and career talks, plus summer camps and research assistantships. It runs through the fall of 12th grade.
deadline_text: Closed. The page says the latest application closed Monday, Dec. 1, with decisions by Dec. 19, 2026. The usual pattern is that applications open the first week of November and close the first week of December. No dates are posted for the next round.

name: VetCamp
org: University of Minnesota College of Veterinary Medicine
what_you_do: A three hour hands-on camp run by vet students. You work cases with practice animals and play a careers game. You also learn about foods that are toxic to animals and ask vet students questions.
grades: 6 to 12 (high school sessions are grades 9 to 12)
deadline_text: No deadline listed. The 2026 sessions were June 10, July 15 and Aug 12. The organizers say new dates are added from time to time.

name: Walker Art Center Teen Arts Council (WACTAC)
what_you_do: Meet weekly during the school year with teens from across the Twin Cities. You connect with contemporary art and artists. You learn how an art center works. You help create programs for other teens.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 school year have closed. Applications for 2027-28 will open in spring 2027.

name: Teen Counselor-in-Training (CIT) program
what_you_do: You help staff with Arboretum summer day camps and gardens. You are a role model for younger campers. You build leadership skills with training and adult mentors.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 are closed. The page says to check back in January 2027 for the next session; an info session is held each February and the 2026 orientation was June 12.

name: Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAV) Camp
org: University of Minnesota, Minnesota CAV program
what_you_do: This is a free one-week day camp. You see and try automated vehicles. You take field trips to companies that work on the technology. You learn from University of Minnesota researchers.
deadline_text: Information about the 2027 camp will be available in early 2027.

name: National Summer Transportation Institute (NSTI)
org: University of Minnesota Center for Transportation Studies
what_you_do: This is a free two-week day camp. You take field trips around the Twin Cities. Trips visit an airport, transit sites and construction sites. You do lab activities. You build a model bridge. You also tour the University of Minnesota.
deadline_text: Dates and application instructions for the 2027 camp will be announced in early 2027.

grades: Volunteers: middle and high school students. TAG: grades 7 to 12.
name: Student Volunteers and Teen Advisory Group (TAG)
what_you_do: Volunteer on weekly or one-time tasks. These include office work, processing new materials and helping in a computer class. You also keep the picture book room neat. TAG members help shape teen programs and meet once a month.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Completed applications are held for six months. Volunteer openings are limited.

grades: High school (students stay until they graduate)
name: TRIO Upward Bound at Waubonsee Community College
city: Aurora, IL (East and West Aurora High Schools)
what_you_do: Free college prep at school. It includes study hall, tutoring, workshops and college visits. You get help with applications. You also explore careers and get internship chances. There is an optional 6 week summer program at the Sugar Grove campus.
deadline_text: The program page does not post a deadline or a school year, and older notes on it pointed to 2024-25. Email upwardbound@waubonsee.edu to ask if applications are open before you apply.

name: Volunteer Opportunities
what_you_do: Help with park clean-up, yearly special events, program help and youth sports coaching. Planting flowers and cleaning up debris and leaves are listed park jobs.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help put on events for younger kids, prepare supplies for programs and help shape library services. Teen volunteers earn service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. You can also stop by the Youth and Teen Department during library hours.

name: Volunteer with Western DuPage Special Recreation Association (age 15 and up)
city: Wheaton and Naperville area, DuPage County, IL
what_you_do: Help run recreation programs and events for people with disabilities. These include games, art, field trips and one-time events. You can volunteer in a seasonal program, at one event or in the office.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted all year. WDSRA keeps your application on file until a fitting role opens.

name: Teen Volunteers and Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help in the Digital Creator Lab, run D&D games, shelve books and decorate Teenspace. You also help at programs. The Teen Library Council plans programs and recommends books. Teens help plan a Haunted Activity House for kids and families on October 30.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. School year volunteering begins the week of Monday, September 14 (no year printed; the weekday matches 2026). Haunted House planning meetings start in spring.

grades: Teens in grades 9 to 12. Kids ages 11 to 13 may apply as library helpers with a parent's approval.
name: Teen Volunteer Program (school year and summer)
what_you_do: Help with youth programs and prepare program materials. Write book reviews and make social media posts. In summer, work the Summer Reading Club booth or the Studio maker space. You help patrons with arts, crafts and tech.
deadline_text: The page says applications for school year teen volunteers are now open, with no closing date stated. Summer 2026 applications closed for the season. 2027 summer dates are not posted yet.

name: Wisconsin 4-H Agriculture Ambassadors
org: University of Wisconsin-Madison Division of Extension, Wisconsin 4-H
what_you_do: Teens in grades 9 to 12 speak up for farming. They lead events across the state and give talks to counties. They build leadership skills with meetings and weekends all year.
deadline_text: Applications run Oct 1 to Nov 15. The page does not state the year; its key dates are in 2027, so this is likely fall 2026. Selection decisions are Jan 6. Confirm the year first.

name: Wisconsin 4-H Summer Academy
org: University of Wisconsin-Madison Division of Extension, Wisconsin 4-H
what_you_do: Teens stay on the UW-Madison campus for five days. They pick a career and college track such as farming, AI, cars, cooking or health.
deadline_text: Registration opens March 8 and closes April 25, 2027. Full refund if you cancel before it closes.

name: Badger Boys State
org: American Legion, Department of Wisconsin (Badger Boys State)
what_you_do: Spend a week at UW-Eau Claire as a citizen of a mock city and county. Elect city, county and state officials and run the government.
deadline_text: The 2027 session is June 13 to 19, 2027 at UW-Eau Claire. No application deadline is posted.

name: Badger Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Wisconsin
what_you_do: Spend a week at UW-Oshkosh in a hands-on program about how government works. Delegates are young women in their junior year of high school.
deadline_text: The 2027 session is June 20 to 25, 2027 at UW-Oshkosh. No application deadline is posted.

name: Wisconsin DECA chapters and state conference
org: Wisconsin DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter at your school and build business and marketing skills. Chapters compete at the Wisconsin state conference in Lake Geneva.
deadline_text: The Wisconsin DECA conference is February 22 to 24, 2027 in Lake Geneva, WI. No membership deadline is posted.

name: Wisconsin Youth Conservation Congress
org: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources with the Wisconsin Conservation Congress
what_you_do: Join a youth group tied to Wisconsin's citizen conservation panel. You get a mentor. You volunteer with DNR staff, such as on fish and wildlife surveys. You learn how natural resource policy is made.
deadline_text: The DNR YCC page gives no application dates or year, and the FAQ linked from it could not be read. Contact YCC Coordinator Kyle Zenz at kyle.zenz@wisconsin.gov or 715-299-0925 to confirm 2026-2027 dates.

name: Wisconsin Youth Apprenticeship
city: Statewide, Wisconsin (run through local regional coordinators)
what_you_do: Work a paid job in a career field you pick. You also take related classes. When you finish, you earn a state Certificate of Occupational Proficiency.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 DWD calendar lists March 1, 2026 as the YA enrollment deadline for grant funding, and April 1, 2026 for YA grant applications for the 2026-27 grant. No 2026-27 student enrollment deadline is posted. Ask your regional coordinator.

name: Wisconsin FFA membership through your school ag class
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's agriculture program. FFA members build leadership and career skills and can go to events like the state convention.
deadline_text: No membership deadline is posted.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Wisconsin Wing
what_you_do: Join a cadet squadron near you. The Wisconsin Wing site lists programs like summer encampment, a wing conference and Legislative Day. Activity details are not on the program pages.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time.

name: Wisconsin YMCA Youth in Government
city: Madison, WI (Model Government), delegations across Wisconsin
what_you_do: Join a delegation and take on a role in a student model government. Write bills, argue court cases or produce media. Or run for Youth Governor. Then meet at Model Government in Madison.
deadline_text: 2026-27: Judicial, Media and Senate registration closes November 18, 2026. Assembly registration closes December 9, 2026. Pre-Gov is January 30, 2027. Model Government is March 5 to 7, 2027.

name: Teen Volunteers and Book Reviews for Service Hours
what_you_do: Help with library tasks at scheduled events, like prepping crafts, pulling materials and cleaning. Or write a book review and get one hour of service for each review.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for each volunteering event on the volunteering calendar. Reviews can be submitted once a month.

name: workNet DuPage Youth Program
what_you_do: Free career help for young adults. It includes one-on-one counseling, resume and interview training, and job placement. You can take job shadows and company tours. You can get paid work at a local worksite. You may get money for training or school.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

name: STEAM@XU Research Immersion (summer pre-college)
what_you_do: Spend one week on campus doing a hands-on research project led by Xavier faculty, with college readiness workshops. Choose a day camp or a residential stay.
deadline_text: The page shows 2026 dates and prices under a 2027 title. The Summer Programs page says 2027 programs are being finalized and that 2027 scholarship applications are open.

name: Youth Job Center: coaching and Paid Work Experiences
org: Youth Job Center (Evanston, Englewood and Pilsen)
city: Evanston, IL (also Englewood and Pilsen in Chicago)
what_you_do: Get free job coaching, workforce readiness training and job placement. A Paid Work Experience is a 10 week job that is part work and part structured learning, with a chance to be hired for good.
deadline_text: The program pages give no deadline or cohort dates and do not say sign-up is ongoing. Fill out the interest form on the sign-up page.

name: Youth Leadership Award and Scholarship
what_you_do: Apply for a $2,000 scholarship. It goes to one high school senior who shows leadership and will go on to higher education. The award honors young people who lead with courage, fairness and service.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The 2026 winner was to be announced at the Leader Luncheon on May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.
